Hearing the instruments sets the heart's strings resonating.
notes_20240423120259.childFriendlyEnglish: Soft rain, a fresh breeze, and music combine to awaken a deep, joyful response in the listener.
notes_20240423120259.simpleHindiExplanation: पुरवाई, रिमझिम वर्षा और वाद्य-संगीत मिलकर मन को भाव-विभोर करते हैं। हृदय के तार झंकृत होना भीतर आनंद और संवेदना जागने का रूपक है।
notes_20240423120259.context: The 2023-04-16 record uses “वाद्य” as its provided word. It joins rainy-season imagery with a musical metaphor and does not point to a specific event.

literalEnglish: A lamb grows restless on hearing the beat of the drum.
The instrument's sound seems to carry the imprint of a mother's praise.
notes_20240423120305.childFriendlyEnglish: A drumbeat startles a young lamb, while the listener hears something motherly or devotional in the same sound. The exact comparison is left open.
notes_20240423120305.simpleHindiExplanation: ढोलक की थाप से मेमना विचलित होता है, पर उसी वाद्य-ध्वनि में माँ के यश या मातृ-स्वर की छाप भी सुनाई देती है। “मां जस” का सटीक आशय अस्पष्ट है।
notes_20240423120305.context: The record is dated 2023-04-16 and gives “वाद्य” as the prompt. The phrase “मां जस” may mean praise of a mother or a mother-like sound; the preserved wording does not settle the ambiguity.

literalEnglish: You gave me everything without my asking, raising your hand in blessing.
Lord, I am grateful to you; remain with me at every moment.
notes_20240423120309.childFriendlyEnglish: The speaker thanks God for unasked-for blessings and prays to keep feeling divine companionship each day.
notes_20240423120309.simpleHindiExplanation: कवयित्री बिना माँगे मिले आशीर्वादों के लिए प्रभु के प्रति कृतज्ञता व्यक्त करती हैं और हर समय उनका साथ बने रहने की प्रार्थना करती हैं।
notes_20240423120309.context: Dated 2023-04-17 with “कृतज्ञ” as the provided word, this is a personal devotional expression of gratitude rather than a reference to an identified public event.

literalEnglish: If you multiply by zero, the value becomes zero.
Place that same zero after a number, and it increases the value.
notes_20240423120313.childFriendlyEnglish: Zero can erase a value in multiplication but enlarge a number when placed after it. The poem playfully shows how position and relationship can change importance.
notes_20240423120313.simpleHindiExplanation: शून्य से गुणा करने पर संख्या शून्य हो जाती है, लेकिन किसी अंक के पीछे शून्य लगाने पर उसका मान बढ़ जाता है। दोहा गणित के सहारे स्थान के महत्व को दिखाता है।
notes_20240423120313.context: The 2023-04-17 poem was written for the prompt “गुणा.” Its arithmetic contrast is clear; any broader lesson about social position would be an inference rather than stated intent.

literalEnglish: Anger.
Never give way to anger; it damages health.
One who remains cheerful looks like a flower in bloom.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423120318.childFriendlyEnglish: Staying angry can hurt our well-being, while a cheerful nature helps a person look and feel bright like a blooming rose.
notes_20240423120318.simpleHindiExplanation: क्रोध को स्वास्थ्य के लिए हानिकारक बताया गया है। इसके विपरीत प्रसन्न रहने वाला व्यक्ति खिले गुलाब की तरह सहज और सुंदर दिखाई देता है।
notes_20240423120318.context: Dated 2023-04-17, the record names anger and its synonyms as the prompt. It offers general wellness advice, not a medical claim about a particular illness.

literalEnglish: Offering.
Everyone knows that holy basil is dear to Krishna.
See the fifty-six-dish offering adorned with basil leaves.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423120322.childFriendlyEnglish: A grand food offering for Krishna is made special by simple basil leaves, which are treasured in devotional tradition.
notes_20240423120322.simpleHindiExplanation: कृष्ण को प्रिय मानी जाने वाली तुलसी से छप्पन भोग सजाया गया है। दोहा बताता है कि भव्य प्रसाद में भी श्रद्धा का सरल प्रतीक तुलसी विशेष महत्व रखती है।
notes_20240423120322.context: The record is dated 2023-04-18 and uses “भोग” and related words as its prompt. It refers to the Vaishnava practice of decorating a large food offering with tulsi leaves.

literalEnglish: All conscious living beings possess life in equal measure.
Lord Mahavira gave this teaching to everyone.
notes_20240423120326.childFriendlyEnglish: Every living creature has life and deserves consideration. The poem connects this respect for all beings with Mahavira's teaching.
notes_20240423120326.simpleHindiExplanation: सभी चेतन जीवों में प्राण को समान मानकर उनके प्रति सम्मान और अहिंसा का भाव रखने की सीख दी गई है। इसे भगवान महावीर के उपदेश से जोड़ा गया है।
notes_20240423120326.context: Dated 2023-04-18 with “प्राण” as the prompt, the verse invokes the Jain teaching associated with Mahavira that living beings deserve nonviolence and regard.

literalEnglish: The monsoon has arrived in full swing, and the wind makes a lively sound.
Everyone is enchanted at the sight of the dancing peacock.
notes_20240423120329.childFriendlyEnglish: The lively wind and a peacock's dance make the arrival of the rainy season feel exciting and beautiful.
notes_20240423120329.simpleHindiExplanation: सावन के आगमन पर हवा का शोर और नाचता मोर सबको मुग्ध कर देते हैं। दोहा वर्षा ऋतु के उल्लास और प्राकृतिक सौंदर्य का चित्र बनाता है।
notes_20240423120329.context: The record is dated 2023-04-19 and names “मुग्ध” as the prompt. Its monsoon scene is poetic seasonal imagery despite the April record date.

literalEnglish: A mafia figure sits in power, and his influence prevails.
The filth of politics can reduce the country to ruin.
notes_20240423120332.childFriendlyEnglish: When criminals gain political power, fear and corruption can harm the whole country. Public leadership should not protect wrongdoing.
notes_20240423120332.simpleHindiExplanation: अपराधी के सत्ता में प्रभावशाली होने को राजनीति की गंदगी कहा गया है। दोहा चेतावनी देता है कि अपराध और सत्ता का गठजोड़ देश को गंभीर नुकसान पहुँचा सकता है।
notes_20240423120332.context: Dated 2023-04-19 with “गंदगी” as the prompt, the poem criticizes the nexus of criminal influence and politics. It names no party, officeholder, or incident.

literalEnglish: Dust.
Mafia figures bite the dust, and even their names disappear.
Heaps of wealth are of no use to them.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423120335.childFriendlyEnglish: Money and a frightening reputation do not last forever. Wealth gained through crime may be useless when consequences arrive.
notes_20240423120335.simpleHindiExplanation: माफिया के पतन के बाद उसका नाम और धन दोनों बेकार हो जाते हैं। दोहा बताता है कि अपराध से जुटाई दौलत स्थायी सुरक्षा या सम्मान नहीं दे सकती।
notes_20240423120335.context: The 2023-04-19 record uses “धूल” and related words as its prompt. It may echo crime news of that period, but no individual is identified in the text.

literalEnglish: Everyone withdrew from me; everyone abandoned my side.
Lord, I pray to you: please keep holding my hand.
notes_20240423120340.childFriendlyEnglish: When the speaker feels deserted by other people, prayer becomes a source of companionship and courage.
notes_20240423120340.simpleHindiExplanation: सबके साथ छोड़ देने पर कवयित्री प्रभु से हाथ थामे रखने की विनती करती हैं। यह अकेलेपन में ईश्वर से सहारा माँगने का भक्तिपूर्ण भाव है।
notes_20240423120340.context: Dated 2023-04-20 with “किनारा” as the provided word, the verse uses abandonment as the setting for a devotional plea. The cause of that feeling is not stated.

literalEnglish: Giridhari Gopal dwells in Meera's heart.
Moved by love for him alone, she dances to the rhythm.
notes_20240423120343.childFriendlyEnglish: Meera's love for Krishna fills her so completely that her devotion becomes joyful song and dance.
notes_20240423120343.simpleHindiExplanation: मीराबाई के हृदय में कृष्ण बसे हैं और उन्हीं के अनुराग में वे ताल देकर नाचती हैं। दोहा उनकी अनन्य कृष्ण-भक्ति को दर्शाता है।
notes_20240423120343.context: The record is dated 2023-04-20 and names “अनुराग” as the prompt. It draws on the widely remembered devotional image of Mirabai singing and dancing in love for Krishna.

literalEnglish: Pride.
Bhagat Singh and Azad are the pride of this country.
The nation remembers Rajguru and Sukhdev.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423120347.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem honours four freedom fighters whose courage and sacrifice remain a source of national pride and remembrance.
notes_20240423120347.simpleHindiExplanation: भगत सिंह, चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद, राजगुरु और सुखदेव को देश का गौरव मानकर याद किया गया है। दोहा स्वतंत्रता-संग्राम के उनके साहस और बलिदान को नमन करता है।
notes_20240423120347.context: Dated 2023-04-20 with “गौरव” and related words as the prompt, the verse commemorates Indian revolutionaries Bhagat Singh, Chandrashekhar Azad, Rajguru, and Sukhdev without tying the remembrance to a stated anniversary.

literalEnglish: Event number: 61.
The heat is very intense in politics today.
The entire opposition community is making its moves carefully.
The opposition groups are proceeding together, brother.
Who will be the leader can be decided later.
Leaving issues aside, wealth was consumed in great quantities.
As conduct came to light, the fierce heat intensified.
notes_20240423120350.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem pictures politics as rising heat: opposition groups try to unite, leadership is unsettled, and revelations about conduct make tensions grow.
notes_20240423120350.simpleHindiExplanation: कुण्डलिया में राजनीति की बढ़ती गर्मी, विपक्ष की सावधान एकता और नेतृत्व के अनिर्णय का चित्र है। अंतिम पंक्तियाँ धन और चरित्र से जुड़े खुलासों की ओर संकेत करती हैं, पर संदर्भ स्पष्ट नहीं है।
notes_20240423120350.context: The preserved text gives event number 61, the prompt “आतप,” and an internal date of 2023-04-16, while the record is stored on 2023-04-20. It appears to comment on contemporary opposition politics and alleged misuse of money, but no people or events are named.

literalEnglish: The dancer performs, every limb moving to the rhythm.
All the spellbound spectators sway along with her.
notes_20240423120354.childFriendlyEnglish: A dancer's graceful movement is so captivating that the audience begins to feel and share the rhythm.
notes_20240423120354.simpleHindiExplanation: नर्तकी के सभी अंग लय में थिरक रहे हैं। उसका नृत्य देखकर दर्शक मंत्रमुग्ध होकर साथ में झूमने लगते हैं।
notes_20240423120354.context: Dated 2023-04-21 with “अंग” as the prompt, the poem describes a dance performance and its effect on the audience; no specific performer or occasion is identified.

literalEnglish: New.
The tree's fresh shoots look like flames.
Sita asks for fire: O ashoka tree, provide a remedy.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423120357.childFriendlyEnglish: Seeing the ashoka tree's flame-coloured new leaves, Sita imagines asking it for fire during her sorrow in Lanka.
notes_20240423120357.simpleHindiExplanation: अशोक वृक्ष की नई लाल कोंपलें अग्नि जैसी दिखाई देती हैं। रामकथा के प्रसंग में दुखी सीता मानो उसी वृक्ष से पावक माँगती हैं; “निदान” यहाँ उपाय के अर्थ में है।
notes_20240423120357.context: The 2023-04-21 record uses “नूतन” and related words as its prompt. It appears to evoke the Ramayana's Ashoka Vatika episode and the traditional image of Sita asking the ashoka tree for fire; wording and retelling may vary.

literalEnglish: Raksha Bandhan is celebrated as a festival of sister and brother.
Both take pride in the love they share.
notes_20240423120400.childFriendlyEnglish: The festival celebrates the affection and caring bond between a sister and a brother.
notes_20240423120400.simpleHindiExplanation: रक्षाबंधन को भाई-बहन के प्रेम का पर्व बताया गया है। दोनों अपने आपसी स्नेह और रिश्ते पर गर्व करते हैं।
notes_20240423120400.context: The record is dated 2023-04-21 and gives “बंधन” as the prompt. It describes the familiar sibling meaning of Raksha Bandhan rather than a dated festival observance.

literalEnglish: Open the scriptures and look through India's history.
Whoever serves cows will never encounter distress.
notes_20240423120404.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem expresses a traditional belief that caring for cows is a virtuous service that brings protection and peace.
notes_20240423120404.simpleHindiExplanation: भारतीय धार्मिक परंपरा का हवाला देते हुए गौ-सेवा को पुण्यकारी माना गया है। संकट न आने की बात आस्था-आधारित विश्वास है, तथ्यात्मक गारंटी नहीं।
notes_20240423120404.context: Dated 2023-04-22 with “सेवा” as the prompt, the verse states a devotional-cultural belief about cow service. Its promise of freedom from distress should be read as faith language.

literalEnglish: Vijayadashami is the festival of truth's victory.
On this day the pride of falsehood, figured as Ravana, was broken.
notes_20240423120407.childFriendlyEnglish: Vijayadashami reminds people that truth and goodness can overcome arrogance and wrongdoing, represented here by Ravana.
notes_20240423120407.simpleHindiExplanation: विजयादशमी को सत्य की जीत का पर्व कहा गया है। रावण को झूठ और अहंकार का प्रतीक बनाकर उसके पराजित होने का संदेश दिया गया है।
notes_20240423120407.context: The 2023-04-23 record was written for “सच्चाई.” It interprets Vijayadashami through the Ramayana symbolism of Rama's victory over Ravana, though the record date is not the festival date.

literalEnglish: When people lived in the village, their ancestors were a source of honour.
A person was identified by naming their father.
notes_20240423120410.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem remembers village life when family lineage strongly shaped a person's social identity. It records that custom without saying it should be the only way to know someone.
notes_20240423120410.simpleHindiExplanation: पुराने गाँव के सामाजिक जीवन में पुरखों की प्रतिष्ठा और पिता के नाम से व्यक्ति की पहचान होने की परंपरा याद की गई है। यह उस समय की व्यवस्था का वर्णन है।
notes_20240423120410.context: The file is stored with a 2023-04-23 record date, while its internal मंच date says 2023-02-23. Written for “गांव,” it recalls lineage-based identity in village society; the date discrepancy is preserved.

literalEnglish: Composition date: 2023-01-15.
Regard as discerning the person who can judge fairly.
The ability to distinguish water from milk is the mark of swans.
notes_20240423120414.childFriendlyEnglish: Like the legendary swan that separates milk from water, a wise person should carefully tell right from wrong before making a fair decision.
notes_20240423120414.simpleHindiExplanation: नीर-क्षीर अलग करने वाले हंस की पारंपरिक छवि से विवेक समझाया गया है। जो सत्य-असत्य या उचित-अनुचित पहचानकर न्याय करे, वही विवेकी है।
notes_20240423120414.context: Stored on 2023-04-23, the preserved first line dates the doha to 2023-01-15. It uses the traditional Indian literary motif of a swan separating milk from water as a metaphor for discrimination and fair judgment.

literalEnglish: A person like the swan can distinguish water from milk.
Knowing truth from falsehood, that person makes the right decision.
notes_20240423120419.childFriendlyEnglish: Good judgment means looking closely enough to separate what is true from what is false before deciding.
notes_20240423120419.simpleHindiExplanation: हंस के नीर-क्षीर विवेक का रूपक लेकर सही निर्णय की क्षमता बताई गई है। समझदार व्यक्ति सत्य और झूठ को पहचानकर फैसला करता है।
notes_20240423120419.context: The 2023-04-23 record names “हंस” as the prompt. Its metaphor comes from the traditional belief in the swan's ability to separate milk from water.

literalEnglish: Topic: open.
The Earth pleads: understand this message, brother.
The forests call out: all trees bring well-being.
Conserve water, or hardship will follow.
If nature becomes angered, the resulting blow will be painful.
Respectfully submitted for review.
notes_20240423120423.childFriendlyEnglish: Earth, forests, and water are given voices to ask people for care. Protecting trees and saving water can help prevent future hardship.
notes_20240423120423.simpleHindiExplanation: धरती और जंगलों को पुकारते हुए दिखाकर पेड़ों की रक्षा और जल-संरक्षण की अपील की गई है। प्रकृति की उपेक्षा से गंभीर हानि होने की चेतावनी भी है।
notes_20240423120423.context: This open-topic rola is dated 2023-04-23, close to Earth Day on April 22. The environmental message is explicit, but a direct Earth Day connection is possible rather than confirmed.

literalEnglish: Kalidasa wrote the story of a yaksha's separation.
The community of poets reads a work such as Meghaduta with special regard.
notes_20240423120427.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem praises Kalidasa's Meghaduta, in which a separated yaksha sends his longing through a cloud messenger.
notes_20240423120427.simpleHindiExplanation: कालिदास के ‘मेघदूत’ में विरही यक्ष की कथा है। दोहा इस काव्य को कवियों और साहित्य-प्रेमियों के लिए विशेष महत्व वाला ग्रंथ बताता है।
notes_20240423120427.context: The record is stored on 2023-04-23, while its internal date is 2023-04-24, and “काव्य” is the prompt. It explicitly refers to Kalidasa's Sanskrit lyric poem Meghaduta.

literalEnglish: Human life is a flower that will wither one day.
Offer it to Rama, and the life will become fulfilled.
notes_20240423120431.childFriendlyEnglish: Life is delicate and temporary like a flower, so the poem encourages dedicating it to faith and goodness.
notes_20240423120431.simpleHindiExplanation: मानव जीवन को एक दिन मुरझाने वाले फूल जैसा क्षणभंगुर बताया गया है। इसे राम को अर्पित करने का अर्थ भक्तिभाव से जीवन को सार्थक बनाना है।
notes_20240423120431.context: Dated 2023-04-24 with “फूल” as the prompt, the verse uses a flower's brief life as a devotional metaphor for mortality and dedication to Rama.

literalEnglish: People travel to Jaisalmer to see the great haveli.
They call it by Patwa Ji's name.
notes_20240423120439.childFriendlyEnglish: Visitors go to Jaisalmer to admire the famous group of ornate mansions known as Patwon Ki Haveli.
notes_20240423120439.simpleHindiExplanation: जैसलमेर की प्रसिद्ध पटवों की हवेली देखने जाने का उल्लेख है। यह नाम वहाँ के पटवा परिवार से जुड़ी ऐतिहासिक हवेलियों के समूह की ओर संकेत करता है।
notes_20240423120439.context: The record is stored on 2023-04-24 with an internal date of 2023-04-25 and the prompt “हवेली.” It appears to refer to Patwon Ki Haveli in Jaisalmer; “बड़ी हवेली” may describe its scale rather than a formal name.

literalEnglish: Seeing the world's falsehood, I began to feel detached.
Remembering the Lord gave me an extraordinary strength.
notes_20240423120458.childFriendlyEnglish: Disappointment with dishonesty makes the speaker turn inward, and prayer provides fresh strength.
notes_20240423120458.simpleHindiExplanation: संसार के छल-झूठ से मन में विरक्ति पैदा होती है। प्रभु का स्मरण कवयित्री को उस निराशा के बीच विशेष शक्ति देता है।
notes_20240423120458.context: Dated 2023-04-26 with “विरक्ति” as the prompt, this is a devotional reflection on detachment. The particular worldly experience behind it is not identified.

literalEnglish: Greed.
Leave attachment and temptation behind, and place your hope in the Lord.
Your wish will be fulfilled; keep faith in your heart.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423120502.childFriendlyEnglish: Instead of chasing every temptation, the poem recommends letting go of greed and building trust through faith.
notes_20240423120502.simpleHindiExplanation: मोह और लालच छोड़कर प्रभु पर आशा और विश्वास रखने की सीख दी गई है। कामना पूरी होने की बात भक्तिपूर्ण भरोसा है, निश्चित परिणाम का दावा नहीं।
notes_20240423120502.context: The 2023-04-26 record uses greed and related words as its prompt. It frames release from temptation through devotional trust.

literalEnglish: This is a short travel memoir about a family of our friends, an episode that often returns to my memory.

It happened about fifteen years earlier. A family of our friends lived in Vashi, Mumbai. The husband was a chartered accountant, his wife a soft-spoken and sociable homemaker, and they had one exceptionally bright and talented daughter. Her ability earned her admission to a medical college in Pune, and the family and their friends were overjoyed by the news.

The well-known shrine of Shani Shingnapur is near Mumbai, and the family visited it often. After their daughter's major achievement, they decided to go there. The next Saturday, mother, father, and daughter hired a taxi for the shrine. They had told the driver not to take another passenger, but he tried to do so when he found one on the way. They objected, but he would not agree, so the family got out midway. After much difficulty they found another taxi and continued toward their destination. A little farther on, they saw a large crowd gathered on the road.

The sight made their hair stand on end. It was the same taxi they had left shortly before, and the account says that no one in it had survived. It had collided violently with an oncoming truck and was completely wrecked.

The three were stunned by what they saw. They felt that Shani Maharaj had made them leave that taxi in order to save them from the accident. For the rest of the journey, their minds held both sorrow and devotion.
On reaching Shani Shingnapur, they worshipped and thanked God. The memoir says that after this event all of us developed profound faith in the shrine.
Whenever the friend has an opportunity, he goes there and thanks the Lord. May Shani Dev remove the hardships from everyone's life.
Praise to the revered deity.
Praise to this sacred pilgrimage place.
notes_20240423120509.childFriendlyEnglish: A family changes taxis after a disagreement and soon sees that the first taxi has crashed. Shocked and saddened, they understand their escape through their faith and offer thanks at Shani Shingnapur.
notes_20240423120509.simpleHindiExplanation: यह यात्रा-संस्मरण एक मित्र परिवार के टैक्सी बदलने और बाद में पहली टैक्सी को दुर्घटनाग्रस्त देखने की घटना सुनाता है। परिवार अपने बच जाने को शनि देव की कृपा मानता है; यह उनकी आस्था-आधारित व्याख्या है, स्वतंत्र रूप से सत्यापित तथ्य नहीं।
notes_20240423120509.context: The memoir was recorded on 2023-04-26 for a travel-memoir competition and says the event occurred about fifteen years earlier. It presents a friend's family experience and their religious interpretation; names, an exact date, and corroborating details are not supplied.

literalEnglish: A lift seems the easy way to go upward.
When electricity is interrupted, the staircase provides the solution.
notes_20240423122511.childFriendlyEnglish: Modern conveniences are helpful, but an ordinary staircase remains dependable when the power goes out.
notes_20240423122511.simpleHindiExplanation: ऊपर जाने के लिए लिफ्ट सुविधाजनक है, लेकिन बिजली बंद हो जाए तो सीढ़ियाँ ही काम आती हैं। दोहा सरल और भरोसेमंद विकल्प का महत्व बताता है।
notes_20240423122511.context: Dated 2023-04-27 with “सोपान” as the prompt, this is everyday wordplay contrasting an electric lift with stairs. No broader event is indicated.

literalEnglish: Every day the sun crosses the sky according to time.
A person who remains industrious overcomes obstacles.
notes_20240423122515.childFriendlyEnglish: The sun's steady routine becomes an example: consistent effort helps people move past difficulties.
notes_20240423122515.simpleHindiExplanation: सूरज की नियमित गति से समयपालन और निरंतरता की सीख ली गई है। कर्मशील व्यक्ति मेहनत के बल पर बाधाओं को पार कर सकता है।
notes_20240423122515.context: The 2023-04-27 record names “समय” as the prompt. It uses the sun's regular movement as a moral analogy for disciplined work.

literalEnglish: Lord Krishna walks with charming, toddling steps.
Anklets are tied around his feet; words cannot finish praising the sight.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423122519.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem lovingly imagines child Krishna toddling along while the anklets on his little feet add to his beauty.
notes_20240423122519.simpleHindiExplanation: बाल कृष्ण के ठुमकते कदमों और पैरों में बँधी पैंजनियों की मनोहर छवि बनाई गई है। उनकी शोभा देखकर भक्त प्रशंसा से भर उठता है।
notes_20240423122519.context: Stored on 2023-04-27, the text gives an internal date of 2023-04-26 and a prompt about feet and synonyms. It uses familiar devotional child-Krishna imagery.

literalEnglish: Strengthen the army and keep modern weapons.
If an enemy attacks, it will be overwhelmed.
notes_20240423122523.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem argues that a well-prepared defence can discourage an enemy from attacking.
notes_20240423122523.simpleHindiExplanation: सेना को मजबूत और आधुनिक अस्त्रों से सुसज्जित रखने की बात कही गई है, ताकि आक्रमण करने वाला शत्रु दबाव में आए। यह सामान्य रक्षा-संदेश है।
notes_20240423122523.context: Dated 2023-04-28 with “सुदृढ़” as the prompt, the verse advocates military preparedness. It does not name a country, conflict, or specific security event.

literalEnglish: Leave greed and attachment behind, and love Hari.
The world's friendships are unreliable; no friend is greater than the Lord.
notes_20240423122526.childFriendlyEnglish: The speaker finds the most dependable friendship in God and recommends loosening the grip of greed and attachment.
notes_20240423122526.simpleHindiExplanation: लोभ-मोह छोड़कर हरि से प्रेम करने की सलाह है। सांसारिक संबंधों को अस्थिर मानते हुए प्रभु को सबसे बड़ा और भरोसेमंद मित्र कहा गया है।
notes_20240423122526.context: The record is dated 2023-04-28 and uses “मोह” as the prompt. It states a devotional preference for divine companionship over worldly attachment.

literalEnglish: Falsehood.
In the Satya Yuga there was a king named Harishchandra.
He never spoke a lie and lived in Ayodhya.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423122530.childFriendlyEnglish: King Harishchandra is remembered as a model of truthfulness who refused to lie even when honesty was difficult.
notes_20240423122530.simpleHindiExplanation: राजा हरिश्चंद्र को सत्य बोलने के आदर्श रूप में याद किया गया है। दोहा उन्हें सतयुग और अयोध्या से जोड़ता है; यह पौराणिक-परंपरागत वर्णन है।
notes_20240423122530.context: Dated 2023-04-28 with falsehood and related words as the prompt, the verse invokes the legendary King Harishchandra. Details of his era and residence belong to traditional narrative rather than verifiable chronology.

literalEnglish: Drink beneficial beverages such as raw-mango cooler, lemonade, and phalsa juice.
Limca, Maaza, and Mirinda are inferior beside them.
notes_20240423122533.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem prefers traditional fruit drinks over packaged soft drinks and encourages choosing refreshing local options.
notes_20240423122533.simpleHindiExplanation: पना, शिकंजी और फालसे के शरबत को लाभकारी बताकर पैकेट वाले शीतल पेयों से बेहतर माना गया है। यह काव्यात्मक पसंद है, विस्तृत पोषण-विश्लेषण नहीं।
notes_20240423122533.context: The record was stored on 2023-04-28 but gives an internal date of 2023-04-25 and the prompt “पेय.” It contrasts traditional Indian summer drinks with named commercial soft-drink brands.

literalEnglish: Do good deeds in the world and always flourish.
Do not earn anyone's anguished curse; receive blessings instead.
notes_20240423122537.childFriendlyEnglish: Treating people well brings goodwill and blessings, while hurting them can leave lasting pain.
notes_20240423122537.simpleHindiExplanation: संसार में अच्छे कर्म करने और किसी पीड़ित की आह न लेने की सीख है। ऐसा व्यवहार अपनाने को कहा गया है जिससे लोगों का आशीर्वाद मिले।
notes_20240423122537.context: Stored on 2023-04-28 with an internal date of 2023-04-29, the poem uses “आह” as the prompt. Here the word means the pained cry or ill will caused by mistreatment.

literalEnglish: Poet-teacher Kalidasa is a sun in the world of poetry.
The radiance of his name continues to spread among poets.
notes_20240423122540.childFriendlyEnglish: Kalidasa is praised as a brilliant poet whose works continue to illuminate literature for later writers and readers.
notes_20240423122540.simpleHindiExplanation: कालिदास को काव्य-जगत के सूर्य के समान तेजस्वी कवि कहा गया है। उनकी रचनात्मक प्रतिष्ठा आज भी कवियों के बीच प्रकाश फैलाती मानी गई है।
notes_20240423122540.context: The 2023-04-29 record uses “कवि” as the prompt and praises the classical Sanskrit poet and dramatist Kalidasa through the metaphor of sunlight.

literalEnglish: All the animals drink together at one watering place.
Everyone understands that the lion is somewhere else.
notes_20240423122544.childFriendlyEnglish: The animals gather peacefully only because the lion is absent. The humorous scene suggests that a shared fear can change how rivals behave.
notes_20240423122544.simpleHindiExplanation: सभी पशु एक घाट पर साथ पानी पी रहे हैं क्योंकि शेर दूसरी ओर है। दृश्य में हास्य है और यह संकेत भी कि शक्तिशाली भय के हटने पर विरोधी साथ आ सकते हैं।
notes_20240423122544.context: Dated 2023-04-30 with “घाट” as the prompt, the verse plays on the idiom of different creatures drinking at one place. A political reading is possible but not confirmed by the text.

literalEnglish: Topic: open.
Kalidasa, special among poets and a poet-teacher, was rich in talent.
He came to be seen as the sun of the literary world.
Reading his books awakens feelings in the heart.
His plays are all excellent, and their characters seem alive.
Respectfully submitted for review.
notes_20240423122548.childFriendlyEnglish: The rola celebrates Kalidasa's talent, saying his poetry stirs emotion and his dramatic characters feel vividly alive.
notes_20240423122548.simpleHindiExplanation: स्वतंत्र विषय के रोला में कालिदास की प्रतिभा, ग्रंथों की भाव-जाग्रत करने वाली शक्ति और नाटकों के जीवंत पात्रों की प्रशंसा की गई है।
notes_20240423122548.context: This open-topic rola is dated 2023-04-30. It offers a broad literary appreciation of Kalidasa without naming particular works or making a claim about one performance.

literalEnglish: Worker or labourer.
A voice is being raised for workers' rights.
The whole world is observing Labour Day today.
Lucknow.
notes_20240423122552.childFriendlyEnglish: Labour Day calls attention to workers' rights and honours the people whose effort keeps communities running.
notes_20240423122552.simpleHindiExplanation: श्रमिकों के अधिकारों के लिए आवाज उठाने और विश्व भर में मजदूर दिवस मनाने का उल्लेख है। दोहा मेहनतकश लोगों के सम्मान पर केंद्रित है।
notes_20240423122552.context: Dated 2023-05-01 with worker, labourer, and related words as the prompt, the poem directly refers to International Workers' Day, commonly observed on May 1.

literalEnglish: Reaching Vibhishana's dwelling, Hanuman was astonished.
Who is this virtuous person living here and singing Rama's praises?
notes_20240423122555.childFriendlyEnglish: In Lanka, Hanuman is surprised and encouraged to find Vibhishana devoted to Rama amid unfamiliar surroundings.
notes_20240423122555.simpleHindiExplanation: लंका में विभीषण के घर पहुँचकर हनुमान राम-गुणगान सुनते हैं और आश्चर्य करते हैं कि यहाँ ऐसा सज्जन भक्त कौन रहता है। यह रामकथा का संकेत है।
notes_20240423122555.context: The 2023-05-01 record names “सज्जन” as the prompt. It appears to evoke a Ramayana or Ramcharitmanas episode in which Hanuman recognizes Vibhishana as a devotee of Rama in Lanka.

literalEnglish: When a father's and son's feet become the same size,
Treat the son as a friend; he has grown into a young man.
notes_20240423122600.childFriendlyEnglish: As a child grows into adulthood, the poem suggests that a parent should add friendship and mutual respect to guidance.
notes_20240423122600.simpleHindiExplanation: पिता और पुत्र के पैर का नाप समान होना बड़े हो जाने का रूपक है। पुत्र के जवान होने पर उसके साथ मित्रवत और सम्मानपूर्ण व्यवहार करने की सलाह दी गई है।
notes_20240423122600.context: Stored on 2023-05-01 with an internal date of 2023-05-02 and the prompt “जवान,” the verse expresses a traditional parenting maxim through foot size as a sign of maturity.

literalEnglish: The gopis speak reproachfully, affirming the Divine with form.
In this bee-song episode, the poet described their anguish.
notes_20240423122604.childFriendlyEnglish: Surdas's Bhramar Geet gives voice to the gopis' pain and their loving preference for the Krishna they can remember in a personal form.
notes_20240423122604.simpleHindiExplanation: सूरदास के भ्रमरगीत में गोपियाँ विरह की पीड़ा के साथ उद्धव के निर्गुण ज्ञान पर ताना करती हैं और सगुण कृष्ण-भक्ति को महत्व देती हैं। दोहा उसी प्रसंग का संकेत देता है।
notes_20240423122604.context: Dated 2023-05-02 with “भ्रमर” as the prompt, the verse refers to Surdas's Bhramar Geet tradition. “सगुण ब्रह्म” contrasts devotion to Krishna's personal form with abstract, formless teaching.

literalEnglish: In the bee-song episode, the cowherd women remember Krishna.
They speak to Uddhava about devotion and love.
notes_20240423122607.childFriendlyEnglish: Missing Krishna, the gopis explain to Uddhava that loving devotion cannot be replaced by a distant philosophical lesson.
notes_20240423122607.simpleHindiExplanation: भ्रमरगीत में गोपियाँ कृष्ण को याद करते हुए उद्धव से प्रेम और भक्ति की बात कहती हैं। उनका विरह व्यक्तिगत कृष्ण-प्रेम की गहराई दिखाता है।
notes_20240423122607.context: The record is stored on 2023-05-02, while its internal date says 2023-05-12, and “भ्रमर” is the prompt. It refers to the literary-devotional dialogue of the gopis and Uddhava; the phrase “भक्ति,प्रेम के बाद” is grammatically compressed.

literalEnglish: Wi-Fi has made messages travel swiftly.
Letters have stopped, and the surroundings have changed.
notes_20240423122610.childFriendlyEnglish: Digital messages arrive quickly through Wi-Fi, but the older habit of writing and sending letters has faded.
notes_20240423122610.simpleHindiExplanation: वाईफाई ने संदेश भेजना बहुत तेज कर दिया है, जबकि चिट्ठी-पत्री का चलन कम हो गया। दोहा संचार तकनीक से बदले सामाजिक परिवेश को दर्ज करता है।
notes_20240423122610.context: Stored on 2023-05-02 with an internal date of 2023-05-03 and the prompt “द्रुत,” the verse contrasts fast internet messaging with the decline of personal letters.

literalEnglish: Within one's home, its own government is at work.
If you manage it properly, the family will remain together.
notes_20240423122615.childFriendlyEnglish: A household needs cooperation, planning, and fair care, much like a small government, so that family relationships stay strong.
notes_20240423122615.simpleHindiExplanation: घर को अपनी व्यवस्था वाली छोटी सरकार के रूप में देखा गया है। उचित प्रबंधन, सहयोग और जिम्मेदारी से परिवार को एकजुट बनाए रखने की बात कही गई है।
notes_20240423122615.context: The 2023-05-03 record uses “प्रबंधन” as the prompt. Its comparison of a household to a government is a domestic metaphor, not a description of a particular family.

literalEnglish: Rivers, mountains, and trees are the ornaments of the earth.
By exploiting them, humankind has become like an offender.
notes_20240423122618.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem pictures rivers, mountains, and trees as Earth's jewellery and warns that exploiting them makes people responsible for harming their shared home.
notes_20240423122618.simpleHindiExplanation: नदियाँ, पर्वत और पेड़ धरती की सुंदरता और संपदा हैं। उनका अंधाधुंध दोहन करके मनुष्य प्रकृति के प्रति अपराध जैसा व्यवहार करता है।
notes_20240423122618.context: Dated 2023-05-04 with “आभूषण” as the prompt, the couplet uses ornament imagery to make a general environmental warning. It names no particular project or incident.

literalEnglish: Once soot stains one's character, it cannot be removed.
The more one tries to wash it away, the farther it spreads.
notes_20240423122622.childFriendlyEnglish: A damaged reputation is compared to smudged kohl: careless or dishonest actions can leave a mark that excuses alone may only spread.
notes_20240423122622.simpleHindiExplanation: चरित्र पर लगा कलंक काजल के दाग जैसा बताया गया है। गलत आचरण से बनी बदनामी आसानी से नहीं मिटती और उसे छिपाने की कोशिश कभी-कभी बात को और बढ़ा देती है।
notes_20240423122622.context: Dated 2023-05-04 with “काजल” as the prompt, the verse turns the way kohl smears into a moral metaphor for a lasting stain on character. No accused person is identified.

literalEnglish: Pride / arrogance
All learned people take pride in the Bhagavad Gita.
It is this country's national scripture, and its teaching is great.
Lucknow
notes_20240423122625.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem expresses admiration for the Bhagavad Gita and values the moral teaching its readers find in it, while its description as a national scripture is the poem's viewpoint.
notes_20240423122625.simpleHindiExplanation: कविता भगवद्गीता के ज्ञान पर गर्व व्यक्त करती है और उसकी शिक्षाओं को महान मानती है। “राष्ट्र ग्रंथ” कहना रचना का श्रद्धापूर्ण मत है, कोई आधिकारिक संवैधानिक दर्जा नहीं।
notes_20240423122625.context: Dated 2023-05-04, this entry labels the idea “अभिमान/घमंड” and ends with “लखनऊ.” The national-scripture wording is devotional or cultural praise; India has no officially designated national scripture.

literalEnglish: Siddhartha attained understanding and at last became the Buddha.
He gave the world pure teachings of peace and nonviolence.
notes_20240423122628.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem remembers Siddhartha's awakening as the Buddha and honours the message of peace and nonviolence associated with his teaching.
notes_20240423122628.simpleHindiExplanation: सिद्धार्थ को बोध प्राप्त होने और बुद्ध बनने का उल्लेख है। उनकी शिक्षा को शांति और अहिंसा का निर्मल संदेश बताकर उसका सम्मान किया गया है।
notes_20240423122628.context: Dated 2023-05-04 with “अंततः” as the prompt, the couplet summarizes the traditional account of Siddhartha Gautama's awakening and teaching. It is a devotional-historical compression rather than a detailed biography.

literalEnglish: Chitragupta Maharaj writes the account of sins and virtues.
He is the accountant who keeps records for Yamaraj in the mortal realm.
notes_20240423122634.childFriendlyEnglish: Using the traditional figure of Chitragupta as a divine record-keeper, the poem reminds readers that both good and bad actions are counted.
notes_20240423122634.simpleHindiExplanation: पौराणिक मान्यता में चित्रगुप्त मनुष्य के पाप-पुण्य का लेखा रखते हैं और यमराज से जुड़े लेखाकार माने जाते हैं। दोहा कर्मों की जवाबदेही का संदेश देता है।
notes_20240423122634.context: Dated 2023-05-05 with “खाता” as the prompt, the verse draws on Hindu tradition about Chitragupta recording human deeds for Yamaraj. Its accounting language is religious imagery, not a literal administrative claim.

literalEnglish: Event number: 64
Let the Ramcharitmanas become a foundation for education.
Within it resides a vast treasury of knowledge.
A vast treasury of knowledge—read it with reverence.
Take its lessons and move forward in the world.
Reading it dispels confusion and showers knowledge like rain.
May rule like Rama's prevail, and may every person be happy.
notes_20240423122638.childFriendlyEnglish: This kundaliya praises the Ramcharitmanas as a source of learning and imagines its lessons helping people build a wise, peaceful, and caring society.
notes_20240423122638.simpleHindiExplanation: कुंडलिया रामचरितमानस को ज्ञान और शिक्षा का बड़ा स्रोत मानती है। श्रद्धा से पढ़कर उसकी सीख अपनाने, भ्रम दूर करने और रामराज्य जैसे सुखी समाज की कामना की गई है।
notes_20240423122638.context: Dated 2023-05-05 and marked event 64, the poem is a devotional endorsement of the Ramcharitmanas. “राम जस राज्य” evokes the ideal of Ram Rajya; it does not specify a modern curriculum or political programme.

literalEnglish: The public is bewildered on hearing all the criticism and commentary.
Ever since they became leaders, they have paid attention to nothing.
notes_20240423122642.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem voices frustration that political leaders seem distracted by constant commentary instead of paying attention to people's real concerns.
notes_20240423122642.simpleHindiExplanation: टीका-टिप्पणी सुनकर जनता के हैरान होने और नेताओं के काम पर ध्यान न देने की शिकायत की गई है। यह राजनीति पर सामान्य व्यंग्य है।
notes_20240423122642.context: Dated 2023-05-07 with “टीका” as the prompt, the couplet appears to use “टीका-टिप्पणी” in the sense of criticism or commentary. No leader, statement, or political event is named.

literalEnglish: Mountains, rivers, and trees are the earth's adornment.
They have become gifts for living creatures.
notes_20240423122650.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates landforms, waterways, and trees not only for making Earth beautiful but also for supporting animals and other life.
notes_20240423122650.simpleHindiExplanation: पर्वत, नदियाँ और पेड़ धरती का श्रृंगार हैं। वे जीव-जंतुओं को जल, आश्रय और जीवन के साधन देकर प्रकृति का उपहार बनते हैं।
notes_20240423122650.context: Dated 2023-05-08 with “श्रृंगार” as the prompt, this is a general appreciation of natural features and their value to living beings, without identifying a particular ecosystem.

literalEnglish: Where there is no conflict over language, religion, or society,
that country grows advanced and its happiness remains abundant.
notes_20240423122653.childFriendlyEnglish: A country can make better progress when people do not fight over language, religion, or social identity and instead live cooperatively.
notes_20240423122653.simpleHindiExplanation: भाषा, धर्म और सामाजिक भेदों पर झगड़ा न हो तो देश उन्नति कर सकता है। आपसी सद्भाव को समृद्धि और खुशहाली का आधार बताया गया है।
notes_20240423122653.context: Dated 2023-05-08 with “समुन्नत” as the prompt, the couplet offers broad civic advice linking social harmony with national progress. It does not refer to a named dispute.

literalEnglish: Do a good deed and forget it; cast it into the river.
On the day you begin to drown, that goodness will lift you.
Lucknow
notes_20240423122701.childFriendlyEnglish: Do good without waiting for praise or repayment; the kindness you quietly give can become support when your own life is difficult.
notes_20240423122701.simpleHindiExplanation: नेकी करके उसका अहसान न जताने की सीख है। निस्वार्थ भलाई कठिन समय में व्यक्ति के लिए सहारा और सद्भाव बनकर लौट सकती है।
notes_20240423122701.context: Dated 2023-05-08, the entry is labelled “भलाई/समानार्थी” and ends with “लखनऊ.” It adapts the familiar saying “नेकी कर, दरिया में डाल”; the rescue image is proverbial, not a promise of literal repayment.

literalEnglish: God dwells within, like a pearl
inside a shell.
There is no need to go far; the Divine is always near.
notes_20240423122706.childFriendlyEnglish: Like a pearl hidden inside its shell, the poem says the Divine can be found within us rather than only in faraway places.
notes_20240423122706.simpleHindiExplanation: ईश्वर को सीप में छिपे मोती की तरह मनुष्य के अंतर्मन में बसे हुए बताया गया है। इसलिए उन्हें खोजने के लिए दूर जाने की नहीं, भीतर देखने की जरूरत है।
notes_20240423122706.context: Dated 2023-05-09 with “समीप” as the prompt, the unusual source line break separates “मोती” from “सीप”; the English preserves all three source lines while reading them as one simile.

literalEnglish: Khan Sahib is helpless; the army and those in power know it.
The economy has collapsed, and Pakistan is burning.
notes_20240423122709.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem reacts to a time of political, military, economic, and public turmoil in Pakistan, portraying a leader called Khan as unable to control the crisis.
notes_20240423122709.simpleHindiExplanation: पाकिस्तान में राजनीतिक टकराव, सेना की भूमिका, आर्थिक संकट और हिंसक अशांति का चित्र है। “खान साहब” संभवतः इमरान खान हैं, पर रचना पूरा नाम नहीं देती।
notes_20240423122709.context: Dated 2023-05-11 with “असहाय” as the prompt, the wording appears to respond to Pakistan's May 2023 crisis around Imran Khan's arrest and ensuing unrest. Because only “खान साब” is written, that identification remains an editorial inference.

literalEnglish: Event number: 65
At Seton Hall in America, the Gita has been accepted.
It has now become compulsory in the curriculum for students.
Compulsory for students, it is read by foreigners.
Deeds are great in the world, and everyone receives knowledge.
The dialogue of Partha and Krishna clears the web of confusion.
The light of the Gita's wisdom makes Seton Hall shine.
notes_20240423122713.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates a report that students at Seton Hall would study the Bhagavad Gita and praises its dialogue about action, knowledge, and uncertainty.
notes_20240423122713.simpleHindiExplanation: रचना सेटन हॉल में गीता पढ़ाए जाने की खबर पर प्रसन्नता व्यक्त करती है। अर्जुन और कृष्ण के संवाद को कर्म, ज्ञान और भ्रम दूर करने वाली शिक्षा माना गया है; अनिवार्य पाठ्यक्रम का दावा अलग से जाँचना चाहिए।
notes_20240423122713.context: Dated 2023-05-11 and marked event 65, the kundaliya names Seton Hall in America and claims the Gita became compulsory there. The institution, programme, and scope are not documented in the note, so that factual claim is preserved but not confirmed here.

literalEnglish: On Buddha Purnima came birth, enlightenment, and nirvana.
Through knowledge of truth and nonviolence, the Buddha brings well-being.
notes_20240423122721.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem honours Buddha Purnima by bringing together the traditional remembrance of the Buddha's birth, awakening, and passing, along with his teachings of truth and nonviolence.
notes_20240423122721.simpleHindiExplanation: बुद्ध पूर्णिमा पर बुद्ध के जन्म, ज्ञान-प्राप्ति और निर्वाण की पारंपरिक स्मृति का उल्लेख है। सत्य, अहिंसा और ज्ञान को लोक-कल्याण का मार्ग बताया गया है।
notes_20240423122721.context: Dated 2023-05-11 with “बुद्ध” as the prompt, the verse reflects the widely observed Buddhist tradition associating Vesak or Buddha Purnima with three major events in the Buddha's life.

literalEnglish: Their attempt backfired, and the three gods faced distress.
Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh became infants before Anasuya.
notes_20240423122724.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem recalls the devotional story in which Anasuya's spiritual power turns the three great gods into babies, reversing the test placed before her.
notes_20240423122724.simpleHindiExplanation: यह अनुसूया की पौराणिक कथा का संकेत है, जिसमें उनकी पतिव्रता-शक्ति के सामने ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और महेश शिशु बन जाते हैं। “लेने के देने पड़े” से परीक्षा का उलटा परिणाम बताया गया है।
notes_20240423122724.context: Dated 2023-05-12 with “शिशु” as the prompt, the couplet refers to a Hindu narrative about Anasuya and the Trimurti. Versions differ on who initiated the test and how it unfolded, so no fuller plot is asserted.

literalEnglish: The son of the wind brought only a tenth share of that radiance.
Even so, Bali could not withstand his brilliance.
Lucknow
notes_20240423122728.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem praises Hanuman's extraordinary power, saying that even a small share of his radiance was too strong for a figure named Bali.
notes_20240423122728.simpleHindiExplanation: पवनपुत्र हनुमान के तेज को अत्यंत प्रबल बताया गया है। केवल दसवाँ अंश लाने और बाली के उसे न सह पाने की कथा-सूचना अस्पष्ट है, इसलिए इसे निश्चित प्रसंग नहीं माना गया है।
notes_20240423122728.context: Dated 2023-05-12, labelled “तेज/प्रखर/समानार्थी,” and ending with “लखनऊ,” the verse invokes Hanuman and “बाली.” The source does not explain whose radiance was divided or whether Bali means Vali, so the exact mythological episode remains uncertain.

literalEnglish: Without animals and other living creatures, the world is incomplete.
The Divine has also given them the right to live.
notes_20240423122731.childFriendlyEnglish: Animals are essential members of the living world, and the poem asks people to respect their right to exist rather than treating Earth as only for humans.
notes_20240423122731.simpleHindiExplanation: जीव-जंतुओं के बिना संसार अधूरा है। उन्हें भी ईश्वर की सृष्टि मानकर उनके जीवन और अस्तित्व के अधिकार का सम्मान करने की सीख दी गई है।
notes_20240423122731.context: Dated 2023-05-12 with “अपूर्ण” as the prompt, this is a general ethical statement about animals and coexistence. It does not point to a particular law or conservation campaign.

literalEnglish: I seek refuge in you, Lord; remain with me at every moment.
The world's path is difficult, so keep holding my hand.
notes_20240423122736.childFriendlyEnglish: The speaker prays for God's steady companionship and imagines divine help as a hand to hold while walking through life's difficult journey.
notes_20240423122736.simpleHindiExplanation: भक्त प्रभु की शरण लेकर हर समय साथ रहने की प्रार्थना करता है। संसार की कठिन राह में ईश्वर का हाथ थामे रहने की छवि सहारे और विश्वास को व्यक्त करती है।
notes_20240423122736.context: Dated 2023-05-13 with “शरण” as the prompt, the couplet is a personal devotional prayer. The difficult path and held hand are spiritual metaphors rather than a named journey.

literalEnglish: Recognizing the omen, Janaki rejoiced inwardly.
It seems that the Lord has come to take me home.
notes_20240423122742.childFriendlyEnglish: Sita notices a hopeful sign and quietly feels that Rama may be coming to rescue her, bringing a moment of joy during separation.
notes_20240423122742.simpleHindiExplanation: जानकी किसी शुभ संकेत को पहचानकर मन में प्रसन्न होती हैं। उन्हें लगता है कि प्रभु राम उन्हें लेने आ रहे हैं; यह रामकथा के विरह और आशा का दृश्य है।
notes_20240423122742.context: Dated 2023-05-14 with “शगुन” as the prompt, the verse appears to voice Sita during the Lanka episode of the Ramayana. The particular omen is not named in these lines.

literalEnglish: Janaki received omens as the left side of her body trembled.
Ramachandra set out accompanied by monkeys and bears.
notes_20240423122745.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem links Sita's traditional bodily omen with Rama beginning his journey alongside the monkey and bear forces, suggesting that rescue is drawing near.
notes_20240423122745.simpleHindiExplanation: जानकी के बाएँ अंग फड़कने को शुभ संकेत माना गया है। दूसरी पंक्ति में रामचंद्र के वानर और भालू सेना के साथ चल पड़ने से उनके उद्धार की आशा जुड़ती है।
notes_20240423122745.context: Dated 2023-05-14 with “शगुन” as the prompt, the couplet draws on Ramayana tradition and the cultural reading of a twitching left side as auspicious for a woman. It presents a literary belief, not medical guidance.

literalEnglish: Subject: free choice
Mother taught me always to live within honourable bounds,
and always to keep reading the Gita, Vedas, and Puranas.
Receive everyone's blessings and adorn your destiny with happiness.
Carefully uphold the honour of both families at all times.
Respectfully submitted for review
notes_20240423122749.childFriendlyEnglish: A mother's advice joins disciplined conduct, continued religious learning, elders' blessings, and care for both the birth family and the family joined through marriage.
notes_20240423122749.simpleHindiExplanation: माँ की सीख में मर्यादा से रहना, धार्मिक ग्रंथ पढ़ना, सबका आशीर्वाद लेना और विवाह के बाद दोनों कुलों का सम्मान निभाना शामिल है। यह पारंपरिक पारिवारिक अपेक्षाओं की आवाज है।
notes_20240423122749.context: Dated 2023-05-14 and marked as a free-choice subject, this rola appears to address a daughter or bride because it asks her to uphold “both families.” That addressee is inferred from conventional wording and is not explicitly named.

literalEnglish: Tiny creatures continually cause damage in this world.
For example, everyone knows how termites hollow things out.
notes_20240423122753.childFriendlyEnglish: Using termites as its example, the poem observes that something physically small can still cause serious hidden damage.
notes_20240423122753.simpleHindiExplanation: दीमक का उदाहरण देकर बताया गया है कि आकार में छोटा जीव भी भीतर-ही-भीतर बड़ी हानि कर सकता है। “तुच्छ” यहाँ कविताई मूल्यांकन है, वैज्ञानिक वर्गीकरण नहीं।
notes_20240423122753.context: Dated 2023-05-14 with “तुच्छ” as the prompt, the couplet generalizes from termites to “small creatures.” Whether it also intends a metaphor for harmful people is possible but not stated clearly enough to assert.

literalEnglish: Resolve every disagreement together through mutual understanding.
Courts give another date and waste time.
notes_20240423122757.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem prefers calm, cooperative settlement of disputes when possible because long court delays can consume time without quickly resolving the conflict.
notes_20240423122757.simpleHindiExplanation: वाद-विवाद को आपसी समझ से सुलझाने की सलाह दी गई है। न्यायालयों में बार-बार तारीख मिलने से समय लगने पर व्यंग्य है, पर हर मामला निजी समझौते से हल हो सके, यह दावा नहीं।
notes_20240423122757.context: Dated 2023-05-16 with “विवाद” as the prompt, the couplet criticizes court delay through the familiar image of repeated hearing dates. It names no case and should not be read as legal advice.

literalEnglish: Art remains alive, and the artist's presence endures.
Even after death, the world continues to remember them.
notes_20240423122806.childFriendlyEnglish: An artist's creations can keep speaking to people long after the artist has died, allowing memory of that person to remain alive.
notes_20240423122806.simpleHindiExplanation: कलाकार की मृत्यु के बाद भी उसकी कला जीवित रहती है। रचनाएँ लोगों को कलाकार की याद दिलाती हैं और उसकी पहचान को समय के पार बनाए रखती हैं।
notes_20240423122806.context: Dated 2023-05-16 with “जीवित” as the prompt, this is a general reflection on artistic legacy. No particular artist or memorial occasion is identified.

literalEnglish: When Hanuman set out in search of Janaka's daughter,
he reached his destination while keeping the Lord in mind.
notes_20240423122810.childFriendlyEnglish: Hanuman's search for Sita succeeds through courage, purpose, and remembrance of Rama, presenting devotion as strength for a difficult mission.
notes_20240423122810.simpleHindiExplanation: हनुमान सीता की खोज में निकलते हैं और राम का ध्यान करते हुए अपने लक्ष्य तक पहुँचते हैं। दोहा भक्ति, साहस और लक्ष्य पर टिके रहने को जोड़ता है।
notes_20240423122810.context: Dated 2023-05-16 with “गंतव्य” as the prompt, the couplet refers to Hanuman's journey to find Sita in the Ramayana. “Destination” most likely points to reaching Lanka or Sita, but the line does not distinguish between them.

literalEnglish: May Shri Rama show grace, so that no obstacle afflicts anyone.
May we be freed from the three kinds of suffering and live happily.
notes_20240423122813.childFriendlyEnglish: The prayer asks Rama to remove obstacles and relieve every kind of suffering so that people may live with greater peace and well-being.
notes_20240423122813.simpleHindiExplanation: श्रीराम से कृपा की प्रार्थना है कि किसी पर विघ्न न आए। आध्यात्मिक परंपरा के “त्रय ताप” से मुक्ति और सुखमय जीवन की कामना की गई है।
notes_20240423122813.context: Dated 2023-05-17 with “विघ्न” as the prompt, this is a devotional blessing. “त्रय ताप” traditionally refers to three broad sources of suffering, though the poem does not define them.

literalEnglish: I examined myself and found a thousand faults.
I corrected my own mistakes, and my world became better.
notes_20240423122817.childFriendlyEnglish: Instead of only blaming others, the speaker looks honestly at personal faults and finds that correcting them improves life.
notes_20240423122817.simpleHindiExplanation: आत्मनिरीक्षण करने पर अपनी बहुत-सी कमियाँ दिखाई देती हैं। उन्हें सुधारने से व्यक्ति का व्यवहार और उसके आसपास का संसार बेहतर लगने लगता है।
notes_20240423122817.context: Dated 2023-05-18 with “निरीक्षण” as the prompt, the couplet applies inspection to the self. “The world became better” is best read as the speaker's changed experience, not a literal transformation of everything.

literalEnglish: Personality and creative work
May your pen never stop and keep creating a body of work.
May your creations remain like mirrors in which your personality is clearly seen.
May your birthday be filled with happiness.
May Mother Sharada's grace fill your pen with light.
notes_20240423122822.childFriendlyEnglish: This birthday greeting wishes a writer lasting creativity, work that honestly reflects who they are, abundant happiness, and Saraswati's blessing on their pen.
notes_20240423122822.simpleHindiExplanation: यह किसी लेखक या कवि के लिए जन्मदिन की शुभकामना है। लेखनी निरंतर चलती रहे, रचनाओं में व्यक्तित्व झलके और माँ शारदा की कृपा से सृजन प्रकाशमान हो—यह कामना की गई है।
notes_20240423122822.context: Dated 2023-05-18 and headed “व्यक्तित्व कृतित्व,” the poem is a literary birthday blessing. The recipient is not named in the preserved body, so no identity is inferred.

literalEnglish: The shameless British feel not the slightest embarrassment.
They stole the Koh-i-Noor and use it to adorn the Crown.
notes_20240423122825.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem angrily describes Britain's possession of the Koh-i-Noor as theft and objects to the diamond being displayed in royal regalia.
notes_20240423122825.simpleHindiExplanation: कोहिनूर हीरे के ब्रिटिश राजपरिवार के पास होने पर तीखा विरोध व्यक्त किया गया है। कवयित्री इसे चोरी मानती हैं और ताज में सजाने को औपनिवेशिक अन्याय के रूप में देखती हैं।
notes_20240423122825.context: Dated 2023-05-18 with “चोरी” as the prompt, the verse states a forceful anti-colonial view of the Koh-i-Noor's acquisition. The diamond's transfer history is contested and more complex than the couplet's compressed wording.

literalEnglish: Illness and mental distress will not afflict you if you keep practising yoga.
Body and mind will both be healthy, and every disease will flee.
notes_20240423122829.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem encourages regular yoga for physical and mental well-being, but its promise that every illness will disappear is poetic encouragement rather than medical certainty.
notes_20240423122829.simpleHindiExplanation: नियमित योग को तन और मन के स्वास्थ्य के लिए उपयोगी बताया गया है। सभी रोग दूर हो जाने की बात काव्यात्मक दावा है; बीमारी में उचित चिकित्सा का स्थान योग अकेले नहीं ले सकता।
notes_20240423122829.context: Dated 2023-05-19 with “व्याधि” as the prompt, the verse promotes yoga using broad health claims. Those claims should not be treated as a guarantee or a substitute for professional care.

literalEnglish: The two-thousand-rupee note has lost its standing.
Hoarders, tears filling their eyes, are bewildered.
notes_20240423122832.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem jokes that people hiding large amounts of money were especially upset when the ₹2,000 banknote was withdrawn from circulation.
notes_20240423122832.simpleHindiExplanation: दो हजार रुपये के नोट वापस लेने की घोषणा पर व्यंग्य किया गया है। दोहे में जमाखोरों को रोता और परेशान दिखाकर काले या छिपाए धन पर चोट की गई है।
notes_20240423122832.context: Dated 2023-05-20, one day after the Reserve Bank of India announced withdrawal of ₹2,000 notes from circulation, the verse appears to react to that decision. “Hoarders” is satirical characterization, not evidence about named people.

literalEnglish: On hearing the news of its farewell, the corrupt were left dejected.
Hoarders are distressed by the two-thousand-rupee note.
notes_20240423122837.childFriendlyEnglish: Treating the banknote's withdrawal as a farewell, the poem satirically imagines corrupt people and cash hoarders becoming anxious.
notes_20240423122837.simpleHindiExplanation: दो हजार के नोट की “विदाई” को मानवीय रूप देकर भ्रष्ट और धन जमा करने वालों की परेशानी पर व्यंग्य है। यह घोषणा के प्रति तत्काल सामाजिक प्रतिक्रिया दर्ज करता है।
notes_20240423122837.context: Dated 2023-05-20 with “विदाई” as the prompt, the couplet appears to concern the Reserve Bank of India's 2023 withdrawal of ₹2,000 notes. Its labels “corrupt” and “hoarders” are rhetorical, not findings about specific holders.

literalEnglish: On the high girdle of the Himalaya, Shiva dwells at Kailash.
He is the creator of the world, bringing forth creation and destruction.
notes_20240423122840.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem pictures Shiva dwelling high on Mount Kailash and honours his divine power over the cycles of creation and destruction.
notes_20240423122840.simpleHindiExplanation: हिमालय की ऊँची पर्वत-मेखला में कैलाश पर शिव का निवास बताया गया है। उन्हें सृष्टि के सृजन और विनाश की शक्ति से युक्त देवता मानकर वंदना की गई है।
notes_20240423122840.context: Dated 2023-05-21 with “कैलाश” as the prompt, the verse uses Hindu devotional cosmology. Calling Shiva the world's creator reflects the poem's theological voice rather than a scientific claim.

literalEnglish: This whole world lives pursuing its own tasks.
Take a vow of service to others, and you will find abundant happiness.
notes_20240423122844.childFriendlyEnglish: Most people are busy with personal needs, but the poem asks us to make a deliberate promise to help others and discover joy in service.
notes_20240423122844.simpleHindiExplanation: संसार को अपने-अपने काम में लगा हुआ देखकर परमार्थ का व्रत लेने की सलाह दी गई है। दूसरों की भलाई के लिए किया गया काम सच्ची खुशी दे सकता है।
notes_20240423122844.context: Dated 2023-05-21 with “व्रत” as the prompt, the verse broadens a vow beyond ritual observance into a commitment to altruistic action. No particular charitable cause is named.

literalEnglish: The speed of light is extremely great, science tells us.
All energy in the universe moves more slowly than this.
notes_20240423122847.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem marvels at light's enormous speed and presents it as the universe's speed limit, using a simple poetic summary of modern physics.
notes_20240423122847.simpleHindiExplanation: विज्ञान के आधार पर प्रकाश की गति को अत्यंत तेज बताया गया है। दूसरी पंक्ति ब्रह्मांड की गति-सीमा का सरल काव्यात्मक रूप है, तकनीकी वैज्ञानिक व्याख्या नहीं।
notes_20240423122847.context: Dated 2023-05-22 with “गति” as the prompt, the couplet refers to the scientific status of light speed. The wording about “all energy” is imprecise; relativity is more accurately framed around information and matter not exceeding light speed in vacuum.

literalEnglish: Complete your work each day with regular discipline.
Then life will pass peacefully, with comfort and ease.
notes_20240423122850.childFriendlyEnglish: Steady daily habits and finishing responsibilities on time can reduce worry and make life feel calmer and more comfortable.
notes_20240423122850.simpleHindiExplanation: अपने काम रोज नियम और अनुशासन से पूरा करने की सीख है। समय पर जिम्मेदारियाँ निभाने से जीवन में चैन, व्यवस्था और आराम बढ़ सकता है।
notes_20240423122850.context: Dated 2023-05-22 with “काम” as the prompt, the verse gives general advice about routine and responsibility. It does not claim that disciplined work removes every hardship.

literalEnglish: Seek treatment for illness and maintain firm confidence.
Keep the hope in your mind that you will recover soon.
notes_20240423122853.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem combines getting proper treatment with hope and confidence, encouraging a patient to care for both medical needs and morale.
notes_20240423122853.simpleHindiExplanation: रोग का उपचार कराने के साथ मन में भरोसा और शीघ्र स्वस्थ होने की आशा रखने को कहा गया है। सकारात्मक सोच सहारा दे सकती है, पर इलाज का परिणाम निश्चित नहीं करती।
notes_20240423122853.context: Dated 2023-05-23 with “चिकित्सा” as the prompt, the couplet explicitly pairs treatment with optimism. It offers encouragement rather than a guarantee of rapid recovery.

literalEnglish: Grandchildren are flowers, and grandparents are trees.
Parents become the branches, making the home like a garden.
notes_20240423122856.childFriendlyEnglish: A multigenerational family is imagined as a garden: grandparents provide roots and shelter, parents connect the family, and grandchildren bloom like flowers.
notes_20240423122856.simpleHindiExplanation: परिवार को चमन का रूपक दिया गया है। दादा-दादी वृक्ष, माता-पिता शाखाएँ और नाती-पोते फूल हैं; सब पीढ़ियाँ मिलकर घर को सुंदर बनाती हैं।
notes_20240423122856.context: Dated 2023-05-24 with “चमन” as the prompt, the poem uses a family-tree image centred on grandparents, parents, and grandchildren. It presents an affectionate ideal rather than describing a named household.

literalEnglish: May Bhadrakali show grace so that every undertaking is auspicious.
She is Shri Krishna's family goddess and a motherly abode of happiness.
notes_20240423122900.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem prays to Bhadrakali for blessings on every task and honours her through a tradition connecting her with Krishna's family.
notes_20240423122900.simpleHindiExplanation: भद्रकाली से सभी काम शुभ होने की प्रार्थना की गई है। उन्हें सुख देने वाली माता और श्रीकृष्ण की कुलदेवी कहा गया है; यह संबंध किसी विशेष परंपरा का दावा हो सकता है।
notes_20240423122900.context: Dated 2023-05-24 with “भद्र” as the prompt, this is a devotional invocation of Bhadrakali. The statement that she is Krishna's family deity is preserved as the poem's tradition-specific claim and is not independently established here.

literalEnglish: Keep beautiful feelings, and pure thoughts will arise.
Do not refuse work undertaken for the good of others.
notes_20240423122906.childFriendlyEnglish: Kind intentions can nurture clear, generous thinking, and the poem encourages us to say yes when we can help with work that benefits others.
notes_20240423122906.simpleHindiExplanation: मन में सुंदर और सद्भावपूर्ण भावना रखने से शुद्ध विचार पैदा होते हैं। परमार्थ यानी दूसरों की भलाई के काम से पीछे न हटने की सीख दी गई है।
notes_20240423122906.context: Dated 2023-05-25 with “विचार” as the prompt, the couplet links inner attitude with altruistic action. It is broad moral guidance, not a reference to a specific service project.

literalEnglish: Under sage Gautama's curse, the woman became stone.
Dust from Rama's feet touched her, and she was redeemed at once.
notes_20240423122920.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem recalls Ahalya's Ramayana story, in which Rama's arrival ends the stony condition caused by Gautama's curse and restores her.
notes_20240423122920.simpleHindiExplanation: यह अहल्या-उद्धार की रामकथा है। गौतम ऋषि के श्राप से शिला बनी नारी को राम के चरणों की रज लगने पर मुक्ति मिलती है; अलग रामायणों में प्रसंग के विवरण बदलते हैं।
notes_20240423122920.context: Dated 2023-05-25 with “चरण” as the prompt, the unnamed woman is identifiable as Ahalya from the Gautama-and-Rama narrative. Versions vary on whether she literally became stone and on the manner of release.

literalEnglish: He saved the swan's life with a selfless heart.
Siddhartha teaches that a protector's claim is greater than a predator's.
notes_20240423122926.childFriendlyEnglish: In the childhood story of Siddhartha and the wounded swan, compassion gives the rescuer a stronger moral claim than the person who tried to kill it.
notes_20240423122926.simpleHindiExplanation: बाल सिद्धार्थ द्वारा घायल हंस को बचाने की प्रसिद्ध कथा का संकेत है। दोहा सिखाता है कि जीवन की रक्षा करने वाला, उसे मारने वाले से नैतिक रूप से बड़ा है।
notes_20240423122926.context: Dated 2023-05-26 with “सिद्धार्थ” as the prompt, the verse refers to the traditional wounded-swan episode from accounts of the Buddha's youth. “भक्षक” describes the would-be killer rhetorically, not a literal animal predator.

literalEnglish: Speak words with love and maintain a gentle feeling.
The blade of harsh words inflicts wounds upon the heart.
notes_20240423123049.childFriendlyEnglish: Gentle speech can protect relationships, while cruel words may hurt someone deeply even though they leave no visible cut.
notes_20240423123049.simpleHindiExplanation: प्रेम और कोमल भाव से बोलने की सलाह है। कटु वचन को धारदार हथियार जैसा बताया गया है, क्योंकि वे मन और हृदय को गहरी चोट पहुँचा सकते हैं।
notes_20240423123049.context: Dated 2023-05-26 with “शब्द” as the prompt, the couplet uses a blade and wound as metaphors for emotional harm caused by harsh speech.

literalEnglish: A hymn gives voice to a devotee's feeling and sings a plea.
The boat is trapped midstream; Lord, please hear the call.
notes_20240423123053.childFriendlyEnglish: The devotee sings to God for help, comparing life's trouble to a boat stranded in dangerous midstream.
notes_20240423123053.simpleHindiExplanation: भजन भक्त के भाव और पुकार को स्वर देता है। मझधार में फँसी नाव जीवन के संकट का रूपक है, जिसमें भक्त प्रभु से सहायता माँगता है।
notes_20240423123053.context: Dated 2023-05-27 with “भजन” as the prompt, this devotional couplet uses the familiar boat-in-midstream image for vulnerability or crisis. No literal voyage is identified.

literalEnglish: The immense banyan tree stands firm in a storm.
It remains green even when drought arrives.
notes_20240423123056.childFriendlyEnglish: The banyan becomes a picture of resilience: deeply established strength helps it face violent storms and long dry periods.
notes_20240423123056.simpleHindiExplanation: विशाल बरगद को तूफान में अडिग और अकाल में भी हरा बताया गया है। यह कठिन परिस्थितियों में धैर्य, मजबूती और टिके रहने का प्रतीक बनता है।
notes_20240423123056.context: Dated 2023-05-27 with “तूफान” as the prompt, the lines may be read both as nature description and as a resilience metaphor. Remaining green through any drought is poetic emphasis, not a botanical guarantee.

literalEnglish: In the light, I see my own reflection beside me.
When the darkness deepened, I forgot every proper way.
notes_20240423123100.childFriendlyEnglish: Light allows the speaker to recognize the self clearly, while deep darkness suggests confusion and losing a sense of how to act.
notes_20240423123100.simpleHindiExplanation: उजाले में अपना प्रतिबिंब साफ दिखाई देता है, जबकि गहरा अंधकार दिशा और व्यवहार का बोध भुला देता है। यह दृश्य आत्मज्ञान और भ्रम का रूपक भी हो सकता है।
notes_20240423123100.context: Dated 2023-05-27 with “प्रतिबिंब” as the prompt, the first line is visual while the second may shift into a moral or psychological metaphor. The intended meaning of “सब ढंग” remains open.

literalEnglish: Do not remain attached to this illusory world.
Offer worship to the Lord, and liberation will be attained.
notes_20240423123105.childFriendlyEnglish: The devotional poem advises loosening our grip on temporary worldly things and turning toward God in the hope of spiritual freedom.
notes_20240423123105.simpleHindiExplanation: नश्वर या माया-मय संसार से अधिक आसक्ति न रखने और प्रभु की वंदना करने की सीख है। भक्ति के द्वारा मुक्ति पाने का धार्मिक विश्वास व्यक्त किया गया है।
notes_20240423123105.context: Dated 2023-05-28 with “आसक्ति” as the prompt, the couplet expresses a devotional path of detachment and liberation. “झूठा संसार” is spiritual language about impermanence, not a claim that lived experience is literally unreal.

literalEnglish: The sparrow has disappeared, and the heat is fierce.
For living creatures and for himself, humankind has become a destroyer.
notes_20240423123108.childFriendlyEnglish: The missing sparrow and severe heat become warning signs that human actions are making the environment dangerous for animals and for people too.
notes_20240423123108.simpleHindiExplanation: गौरैया के कम दिखाई देने और भीषण गर्मी को पर्यावरण संकट से जोड़ा गया है। मनुष्य की गतिविधियाँ जीव-जंतुओं के साथ स्वयं उसके जीवन के लिए भी खतरा बन रही हैं।
notes_20240423123108.context: Dated 2023-05-28 with “गायब” as the prompt, the verse appears to connect sparrow decline and extreme heat with human environmental harm. It provides no location or data, so the causal link remains poetic advocacy rather than a measured study.

literalEnglish: With vermilion adorning her hair parting, she wears red bangles.
Wearing toe rings and anklets, the bride looks splendid.
notes_20240423123111.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem admires a bride dressed in traditional married adornments, from sindoor and red bangles to toe rings and musical anklets.
notes_20240423123111.simpleHindiExplanation: दुल्हन के पारंपरिक श्रृंगार का चित्र है—माँग में सिंदूर, लाल चूड़ियाँ, बिछिया और पायल। इन आभूषणों से सजी बन्नो की सुंदरता की प्रशंसा की गई है।
notes_20240423123111.context: Dated 2023-05-29 with “पायल” as the prompt, the couplet presents North Indian bridal and married-woman adornments. It does not identify a particular wedding or bride.

literalEnglish: When something is entrusted to you, bury any dishonest intention.
Premchand wrote it down; read the novel Gaban.
notes_20240423123115.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem warns us to be honest with money or valuables placed in our care and points readers toward Premchand's Gaban for a story about temptation and wrongdoing.
notes_20240423123115.simpleHindiExplanation: किसी की धरोहर अपने पास हो तो बेईमान नीयत को दबा देने, यानी ईमानदार रहने की सीख है। प्रेमचंद के उपन्यास “गबन” का उल्लेख लालच और धन-संबंधी नैतिकता की ओर संकेत करता है।
notes_20240423123115.context: Dated 2023-05-29 with “गबन” as the prompt, the second line explicitly names Premchand's novel. The first line is grammatically compressed; reading “नियत कीजिए दफन” as burying dishonest intent is an editorial interpretation.

literalEnglish: In this illusory world, ignorance is a veil.
As soon as the veil is lifted, one finds God.
notes_20240423123118.childFriendlyEnglish: Not understanding clearly can hide what is true, like a veil over our eyes. The poem says that wisdom can help us recognize the Divine.
notes_20240423123118.simpleHindiExplanation: मायावी संसार में अज्ञान को घूँघट कहा गया है। ज्ञान का पर्दा हटते ही मनुष्य को ईश्वर का बोध होने लगता है।
notes_20240423123118.context: The preserved record is dated 2023-05-30 and names “घूंघट” as the provided word. The veil appears to be a spiritual metaphor for ignorance; this is an editorial reading, not confirmed authorial intent.

literalEnglish: On Ganga Dussehra in the month of Jyeshtha, the Ganga crossed from heaven.
She began to flow upon the earth, washing sins away.
notes_20240423123122.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem remembers the sacred story of the Ganga coming from heaven to flow on earth and bless those who honour her.
notes_20240423123122.simpleHindiExplanation: दोहा गंगा दशहरा और गंगा के स्वर्ग से धरती पर अवतरण की पौराणिक कथा का स्मरण करता है। गंगा को पापों से मुक्ति देने वाली पवित्र नदी माना गया है।
notes_20240423123122.context: The record is dated 2023-05-31 and gives “गंगा” as the prompt. Its wording appears to invoke the Hindu tradition of Ganga Dussehra, observed in Jyeshtha and associated with the Ganga’s descent to earth.

literalEnglish: Science stands astonished, unable to reach a conclusion.
Hearing the story of Ram Setu, it keeps examining the stones.
notes_20240423123126.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem places scientific curiosity beside the traditional story of Ram Setu. It shows people wondering how the stones and the old account should be understood.
notes_20240423123126.simpleHindiExplanation: यह दोहा रामसेतु की कथा और वैज्ञानिक जाँच को साथ रखता है। विज्ञान के चकित होने की बात काव्यात्मक है; इससे किसी वैज्ञानिक निष्कर्ष की पुष्टि नहीं होती।
notes_20240423123126.context: The record is dated 2023-05-31, while its internal मंच date is 2023-06-01, and the prompt is “चकित.” It refers to Ram Setu through devotional-traditional wording; no scientific finding is established by the verse.

literalEnglish: Keep a noble outlook, regarding no one as high or low.
Look at the lotus flower, blooming amid the mud.
notes_20240423123129.childFriendlyEnglish: True greatness means treating everyone with respect. Like a lotus growing in mud, goodness can flourish without looking down on its surroundings.
notes_20240423123129.simpleHindiExplanation: सच्ची महानता ऊँच-नीच का भेद न करने में है। कीचड़ में खिलता कमल बताता है कि कठिन या साधारण परिस्थिति में भी श्रेष्ठ गुण विकसित हो सकते हैं।
notes_20240423123129.context: The preserved record is dated 2023-06-01, with an internal मंच date of 2023-06-02, and names “महानता” as the prompt. The lotus is used as a moral image for dignity without social hierarchy.

literalEnglish: When beginning a task, be sure to seek opinions and advice.
Climb the steps of experience, and pleasing results will follow.
notes_20240423123133.childFriendlyEnglish: Before starting something important, listening to experienced people can help. Their advice may guide us toward a better result.
notes_20240423123133.simpleHindiExplanation: किसी काम की शुरुआत से पहले राय और सलाह लेने की सीख दी गई है। अनुभवी लोगों से सीखने पर सही निर्णय और अच्छे परिणाम मिलने की संभावना बढ़ती है।
notes_20240423123133.context: The record is dated 2023-06-02 and identifies “राय” as the provided word. It offers general practical advice and does not point to a specific incident.

literalEnglish: Hanuman lengthened his tail and performed an extraordinary feat.
Lanka ran short of cloth, ghee, and oil.
notes_20240423123140.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem retells the Ramayana scene in which Hanuman’s tail keeps growing while people try to wrap it, leading to his famous burning of Lanka.
notes_20240423123140.simpleHindiExplanation: दोहा रामायण के उस प्रसंग को याद करता है जिसमें हनुमान की पूँछ पर कपड़ा और तेल बाँधा गया। बढ़ती पूँछ के कारण लंका में वस्त्र, घी और तेल कम पड़ने का वर्णन हास्यपूर्ण ढंग से किया गया है।
notes_20240423123140.context: The preserved date is 2023-06-04, though the internal मंच date reads 2023-06-02, and the prompt is “अनोखा.” The wording clearly appears to retell Hanuman’s burning of Lanka in the Ramayana tradition.

literalEnglish: Do not impose an unsuitable burden of education upon children.
Teach them subjects that match their interests.
notes_20240423123144.childFriendlyEnglish: Children learn better when adults notice what they enjoy and can manage, instead of forcing every child into the same heavy course of study.
notes_20240423123144.simpleHindiExplanation: बच्चों पर अनुपयुक्त पढ़ाई का बोझ न डालने और उनकी रुचि के अनुसार विषय चुनने की सलाह दी गई है। शिक्षा को बच्चे की क्षमता और पसंद से जोड़ना इसका मुख्य भाव है।
notes_20240423123144.context: The record is dated 2023-06-04, with an internal मंच date of 2023-06-05, and supplies “रुचि” as the prompt. It is a general observation about child-centred education.

literalEnglish: Know the little lamp that false brightness kept deceiving.
It feels welcome in the darkness, for it lights the world.
notes_20240423123150.childFriendlyEnglish: A small lamp may seem unimportant in daylight, but in darkness even its modest glow becomes valuable. Small acts can matter when they are truly needed.
notes_20240423123150.simpleHindiExplanation: नन्हे दीपक की उपयोगिता अँधेरे में समझ आती है, जब उसका छोटा प्रकाश भी संसार को रोशन करता है। पहली पंक्ति का “उजियारा छलता रहा” अस्पष्ट है, इसलिए अर्थ सावधानी से लिया गया है।
notes_20240423123150.context: The preserved record is dated 2023-06-05 and names “भला” as the prompt. The contrast between brightness, darkness, and a small lamp supports a reading about overlooked usefulness, but the first line’s exact syntax is ambiguous.

literalEnglish: Enchanting is the form of dark-hued Krishna, with his great wide eyes.
A flute adorns his lips, and a Vaijayanti garland his chest.
notes_20240423123154.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem lovingly pictures Krishna with large eyes, a flute at his lips, and a flower garland over his heart.
notes_20240423123154.simpleHindiExplanation: दोहा श्रीकृष्ण के मोहक रूप का वर्णन करता है—विशाल नेत्र, अधरों पर बाँसुरी और हृदय पर वैजयंती माला। इसमें भक्तिपूर्ण सौंदर्य-चित्रण है।
notes_20240423123154.context: The record is dated 2023-06-06 and gives “मोहिनी” as the prompt. “श्याम,” the flute, and the Vaijayanti garland identify the figure as Krishna in devotional imagery.

literalEnglish: Chlorophyll in a leaf arranges the making of food.
It carries out energy synthesis through its connection with the sun.
notes_20240423123157.childFriendlyEnglish: Green leaves use sunlight to help a plant make food. The poem turns the basic idea of photosynthesis into two rhyming lines.
notes_20240423123157.simpleHindiExplanation: पत्तियों में मौजूद पर्णहरिम सूर्य के प्रकाश की सहायता से भोजन बनाने की प्रक्रिया में काम करता है। दोहा प्रकाश-संश्लेषण के वैज्ञानिक विचार को सरल काव्य-रूप देता है।
notes_20240423123157.context: The preserved record is dated 2023-06-06 and names “पात” as the prompt. The verse describes chlorophyll and photosynthesis in simplified language rather than giving a complete scientific explanation.

literalEnglish: Do not commit any injustice against a brother.
Look at Ravana’s fate: his whole lineage was destroyed.
notes_20240423123200.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem warns against treating a brother unfairly and uses Ravana’s downfall as a lesson about how wrongdoing can harm an entire family.
notes_20240423123200.simpleHindiExplanation: भाई के साथ अन्याय न करने की सीख दी गई है। रावण के विनाश को उदाहरण बनाकर बताया गया है कि अधर्म का परिणाम पूरे कुल को भुगतना पड़ सकता है।
