notes_20240423123951.simpleHindiExplanation: मनुष्य का शरीर नश्वर है और मृत्यु निश्चित है। इसलिए देह का अभिमान छोड़कर विनम्र और सार्थक जीवन जीने की सीख दी गई है।
notes_20240423123951.context: The record timestamp is 2023-07-21, while the embedded date is 17/7/2023, and the prompt is “अटल” (inevitable or steadfast). The couplet presents a general spiritual reflection on mortality.

literalEnglish: Attend to the subject matter; do not let your thoughts wander.
Keep the principal plot as the foundation of your writing.
notes_20240423123954.childFriendlyEnglish: Clear writing stays focused on its topic and builds every part around the main story.
notes_20240423123954.simpleHindiExplanation: लेखन करते समय विषय पर ध्यान रखना और विचारों को भटकने न देना चाहिए। मुख्य कथानक को आधार बनाने से रचना स्पष्ट और सुसंगत रहती है।
notes_20240423123954.context: The record is dated 2023-07-22 and uses “वस्तु” as the prompt. Here “विषय-वस्तु” is understood in its literary sense of subject matter rather than as a physical object.

literalEnglish: With the advent of currency, goods acquired stated prices.
Trade became easier for everyone, as goods could be sold by measure.
notes_20240423123957.childFriendlyEnglish: Money gave goods a common price and made buying, selling, and measuring exchanges easier.
notes_20240423123957.simpleHindiExplanation: मुद्रा के आने से वस्तुओं का मूल्य तय करना और खरीद-बिक्री करना आसान हुआ। नाप-तोल के आधार पर व्यापार अधिक व्यवस्थित बन गया।
notes_20240423123957.context: The record is dated 2023-07-22 and answers the prompt “वस्तु.” It offers a compressed account of currency and trade, not a detailed historical claim about when pricing began.

literalEnglish: Living beings and objects are different—why do people forget this?
They exploit living creatures and treat them as things to consume.
notes_20240423124001.childFriendlyEnglish: Animals and other living beings are not objects; treating them only as resources ignores their life and suffering.
notes_20240423124001.simpleHindiExplanation: जीव और निर्जीव वस्तु में अंतर है। किसी जीव को केवल उपयोग या उपभोग की चीज मानकर उसका शोषण करना गलत बताया गया है।
notes_20240423124001.context: The record is dated 2023-07-22 and uses “वस्तु” as the prompt. The couplet makes an ethical distinction between living beings and commodities; it does not identify one industry or practice.

literalEnglish: Speak Hindi with confidence; do not feel hesitant.
Help the language advance, while keeping an indigenous outlook.
notes_20240423124006.childFriendlyEnglish: People can support Hindi by speaking it confidently and valuing their own linguistic heritage without embarrassment.
notes_20240423124006.simpleHindiExplanation: हिंदी बोलने में संकोच नहीं करना चाहिए। आत्मविश्वास से भाषा का प्रयोग और सम्मान करने पर उसका विकास होता है तथा स्वदेशी भाषाई सोच मजबूत होती है।
notes_20240423124006.context: The record is dated 2023-07-23 and names “संकोच” as the prompt. It advocates confident use of Hindi; it does not explicitly reject multilingualism or other languages.

literalEnglish: Seeing his tiny form, Sita feels hesitant.
She tells Bajrangi that the night-roaming demons are extremely wicked.
notes_20240423124009.childFriendlyEnglish: Sita doubts whether Hanuman’s small form can overcome Lanka’s dangerous demons, so her caution reflects the peril around her.
notes_20240423124009.simpleHindiExplanation: सीता हनुमान का छोटा रूप देखकर संकोच करती हैं और लंका के दुष्ट राक्षसों का खतरा बताती हैं। उनका संदेह परिस्थिति की कठिनाई और हनुमान की शक्ति के अभी छिपे होने से जुड़ा है।
notes_20240423124009.context: The record is dated 2023-07-23 and answers “संकोच.” It appears to refer to the Ramayana meeting in Lanka, with Bajrangi as a name for Hanuman; the source does not cite a specific recension.

literalEnglish: Seeing Krishna’s splendour, Sudama pauses in thought.
He keeps his gift of rice hidden, feeling shy at heart.
notes_20240423124013.childFriendlyEnglish: Sudama’s humble gift seems tiny beside Krishna’s wealth, yet friendship and affection give it true worth.
notes_20240423124013.simpleHindiExplanation: कृष्ण का वैभव देखकर सुदामा अपनी छोटी-सी चावल की भेंट देने में संकोच करते हैं। कथा बताती है कि सच्चे प्रेम और मित्रता में उपहार की कीमत नहीं, भावना महत्वपूर्ण होती है।
notes_20240423124013.context: The record timestamp is 2023-07-25, while the embedded prompt date is 23/7/2023. It evokes the Krishna–Sudama story and interprets “तंदुल” as rice; narrative details may vary across retellings.

literalEnglish: Householder, sit in the fire corner and perform the sacred rite.
Pronounce “svaha” and present the offering.
notes_20240423124017.childFriendlyEnglish: A fire ritual is performed with an appointed place, spoken invocation, and a respectful offering.
notes_20240423124017.simpleHindiExplanation: यज्ञ में यजमान अग्नि-कोण में बैठकर विधि से आहुति देता है और ‘स्वाहा’ का उच्चारण करता है। रचना अनुष्ठान की अनुशासित और श्रद्धापूर्ण प्रक्रिया बताती है।
notes_20240423124017.context: The record is dated 2023-07-25, with an embedded date of 24/7/2023, and uses “आहुति” as the prompt. The lines describe general yajna practice; exact ritual rules depend on tradition.

literalEnglish: Flowers have bloomed in the garden, releasing a fragrant scent.
No prohibition can be imposed upon this gift of nature.
notes_20240423124021.childFriendlyEnglish: The beauty and fragrance of flowers spread freely; nature’s gifts cannot be confined by human rules.
notes_20240423124021.simpleHindiExplanation: बाग के फूलों की सुगंध अपने आप चारों ओर फैलती है। प्रकृति की ऐसी देन को रोकना या उस पर प्रतिबंध लगाना संभव नहीं है।
notes_20240423124021.context: The record is dated 2023-07-25 and names “प्रतिबंध” as the prompt. It uses fragrance as a poetic example of something naturally free rather than referring to a legal restriction.

literalEnglish: Air, fire, water, and land were given in boundless measure to everyone.
Nature gives without restriction; its grace has no end.
notes_20240423124028.childFriendlyEnglish: Nature shares the basic elements generously with all life, reminding people not to take that abundance for granted.
notes_20240423124028.simpleHindiExplanation: हवा, अग्नि, जल और धरती प्रकृति ने सबको बिना भेद और रोक के दिए हैं। इन अनमोल साधनों को उसकी असीम कृपा मानकर सम्मान और संरक्षण करना चाहिए।
notes_20240423124028.context: The record is dated 2023-07-25 and uses “प्रतिबंध” as its prompt. “अनंत” and “बिन प्रतिबंध” express generosity poetically, not a scientific claim that natural resources are inexhaustible.

literalEnglish: When newspapers are printed without arbitrary restriction,
understand this as part of the essence of democracy in the country.
notes_20240423124031.childFriendlyEnglish: A democracy depends on newspapers being able to publish freely and keep citizens informed.
notes_20240423124031.simpleHindiExplanation: लोकतंत्र में समाचार-पत्रों की स्वतंत्रता महत्वपूर्ण है। बिना अनुचित रोक के जानकारी और विचार प्रकाशित होना जनता को जागरूक रखने का आधार बनता है।
notes_20240423124031.context: The record is dated 2023-07-25 and names “प्रतिबंध” as the prompt. It expresses a general ideal of press freedom and does not identify a particular ban, newspaper, or government action.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “time.”
Diligent people always remain mindful of time.
They live free from worry and earn respect in the world.
notes_20240423124034.childFriendlyEnglish: Using time carefully helps hardworking people stay prepared, avoid needless worry, and gain others’ trust.
notes_20240423124034.simpleHindiExplanation: कर्मशील व्यक्ति समय का ध्यान रखता है और काम को टालता नहीं। समय का सही उपयोग चिंता घटाता है और समाज में सम्मान दिलाता है।
notes_20240423124034.context: The record is dated 2023-07-25 and includes “समय” as a provided word within the parsed body. The lesson is general time management, not a claim that diligence removes every source of anxiety.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “saint.”
Those who remember God and keep their feelings pure,
and always work for public welfare, are enlightened saints.
notes_20240423124039.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem recognizes a true saint through sincere devotion, a clean heart, wisdom, and service to others.
notes_20240423124039.simpleHindiExplanation: संत वही माना गया है जो प्रभु का स्मरण करे, मन की भावना शुद्ध रखे और जनहित में काम करे। भक्ति के साथ सेवा और विवेक भी आवश्यक बताए गए हैं।
notes_20240423124039.context: The record is dated 2023-07-26 and includes the provided word “संत” in the body. It offers the poem’s ethical definition of a saint rather than identifying a historical religious figure.

literalEnglish: Pray every day and rise early at dawn.
Bow your head to God, then move toward your goal.
notes_20240423124048.childFriendlyEnglish: A steady morning routine of prayer, humility, and purposeful action can help a person work toward a goal.
notes_20240423124048.simpleHindiExplanation: प्रतिदिन भोर में उठकर प्रार्थना और ईश्वर को प्रणाम करने के बाद अपने लक्ष्य की ओर बढ़ने की सीख है। नियमितता, श्रद्धा और कर्म को साथ रखा गया है।
notes_20240423124048.context: The record is dated 2023-07-26 and uses “नित्य” (daily) as its prompt. The couplet presents a devotional routine as guidance, not as a guarantee of success.

literalEnglish: Seeing the monkey in a tiny form, Sita was astonished.
Then he grew as tall as a mountain—the mighty Bajrang.
notes_20240423124051.childFriendlyEnglish: Hanuman changes from a tiny figure to a mountain-like form, revealing the immense strength hidden behind his humble appearance.
notes_20240423124051.simpleHindiExplanation: सीता हनुमान का छोटा रूप देखकर आश्चर्य करती हैं। तब वे पर्वत के समान विशाल रूप दिखाकर अपनी छिपी हुई शक्ति और सामर्थ्य प्रकट करते हैं।
notes_20240423124051.context: The record is dated 2023-07-28 and names “लघु” as the prompt. It appears to retell Hanuman displaying a larger form before Sita in the Ramayana tradition.

literalEnglish: While searching for Janaka’s daughter, he kept a tiny form.
The monkey entered the city of Lanka, where the ten-headed king ruled.
notes_20240423124054.childFriendlyEnglish: Hanuman makes himself small so he can enter Ravana’s Lanka quietly while searching for Sita.
notes_20240423124054.simpleHindiExplanation: सीता की खोज में हनुमान छोटा रूप धारण करके रावण की लंका में प्रवेश करते हैं। यहां लघु रूप बुद्धिमानी, सावधानी और उद्देश्यपूर्ण साहस का साधन है।
notes_20240423124054.context: The record is dated 2023-07-28 and uses “लघु” as the prompt. “Janaka’s daughter” refers to Sita and the ten-headed ruler to Ravana in the Ramayana episode.

literalEnglish: 1. The elephant is a huge creature, raising dust at every step.
It has no needless fear of a creature as tiny as an ant.
[Stanza break]
2. Do not forget the small merely because something large stands before you.
A cauliflower is not used as a flower in worship.
notes_20240423124059.childFriendlyEnglish: Size alone does not decide worth: the small should not be dismissed, and something large or flower-shaped may still be unsuitable for a particular purpose.
notes_20240423124059.simpleHindiExplanation: पहले उदाहरण में हाथी और चींटी से बड़े-छोटे का अंतर दिखाया गया है। दूसरे में सीख है कि केवल आकार देखकर किसी लघु वस्तु का महत्व न भूलें; नाम या रूप समान होने पर भी हर चीज का उपयोग समान नहीं होता।
notes_20240423124059.context: The record is dated 2023-07-28 and uses “लघु” as the prompt. The second couplet turns on a playful contrast between large and small and on cauliflower containing “flower” in its Hindi name; its exact intended linkage is somewhat ambiguous.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “beautiful.”
No attire is as beautiful as a sari.
It enhances a woman’s dignity, and everyone offers respect.
notes_20240423124103.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates the sari as graceful clothing that can express beauty, dignity, and cultural esteem.
notes_20240423124103.simpleHindiExplanation: साड़ी को सुंदर और गरिमापूर्ण परिधान के रूप में सराहा गया है। रचना के अनुसार इसे पहनने से नारी की शोभा बढ़ती है और सांस्कृतिक सम्मान का भाव जुड़ता है।
notes_20240423124103.context: The record timestamp is 2023-07-28, while the embedded date is 29/7/2023, and “सुंदर” is included as the provided word. The praise reflects the poem’s viewpoint, not a universal ranking of clothing.

literalEnglish: Meghnad aimed the divine weapon at Lakshman.
When Shri Ram became distraught, Hanuman brought the healer.
He brought the Sanjeevani herb and quickly saved a life.
Hanuman brought relief to the anguished Ram.
A person who remembers Hanuman need not remain distressed.
All troubles recede, for he is a treasury of grace.
notes_20240423124107.childFriendlyEnglish: The first two verses recall Hanuman’s urgent help when Lakshman was wounded; the last turns that rescue into faith that remembering Hanuman brings courage in distress.
notes_20240423124107.simpleHindiExplanation: पहले दो दोहों में मेघनाद के प्रहार से लक्ष्मण के घायल होने, वैद्य और संजीवनी लाने तथा हनुमान द्वारा संकट दूर करने का प्रसंग है। अंतिम दोहा हनुमान-स्मरण को संकट में आशा और कृपा का आधार बताता है।
notes_20240423124107.context: The record is dated 2023-07-29 and names “विकल” (distraught) as the prompt. It combines Ramayana narrative with a devotional assurance; details such as who was brought first vary among retellings.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “wedding garland.”
Arjuna struck the target and won the bride-choosing contest.
Drupada’s daughter lovingly placed the victory garland upon him.
notes_20240423124111.childFriendlyEnglish: Arjuna’s skill wins Draupadi’s contest, and the garland marks her choice and his victory.
notes_20240423124111.simpleHindiExplanation: अर्जुन लक्ष्य भेदकर स्वयंवर जीतते हैं और द्रुपद की पुत्री द्रौपदी उन्हें जयमाला पहनाती हैं। यह कौशल, विजय और वरण का पौराणिक प्रसंग है।
notes_20240423124111.context: The record timestamp is 2023-07-30 and includes “जयमाला” as the provided word. It clearly evokes Draupadi’s svayamvara in the Mahabharata tradition, though retellings differ in detail.

literalEnglish: Within the measure of one inch, we counted eight threads.
We memorized this lesson in order to learn arithmetic.
notes_20240423124115.childFriendlyEnglish: An old classroom rule links eight thread-width units with one inch, showing how measurement facts were learned by memory.
notes_20240423124115.simpleHindiExplanation: एक इंच में आठ ‘सूत’ गिनने का पुराना माप-पाठ याद करने की बात है। रचना बताती है कि गणित और नाप सीखने के लिए ऐसे संबंध कंठस्थ किए जाते थे।
notes_20240423124115.context: The record is dated 2023-07-30 and uses “सूत” as the prompt. Here “सूत” appears to mean a small traditional unit associated with inch measurement, not simply sewing thread; exact conventions may vary.

literalEnglish: In the struggle for freedom, all the worthy children of the nation joined the race.
Everyone spun thread to make khadi.
notes_20240423124127.childFriendlyEnglish: During India’s freedom movement, spinning thread for khadi became a way for ordinary people to support self-reliance.
notes_20240423124127.simpleHindiExplanation: स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में देशवासियों ने खादी के लिए सूत काता। यह काम स्वदेशी, आत्मनिर्भरता और आजादी के सामूहिक प्रयास का प्रतीक बना।
notes_20240423124127.context: The record is dated 2023-07-30 and names “सूत” as the prompt. It appears to refer broadly to khadi spinning during India’s independence movement, without naming a particular campaign or participant.

literalEnglish: Khadi is made from spun thread; it is a product of our own country.
We wear it with our heads held high.
notes_20240423124135.childFriendlyEnglish: Wearing locally made khadi can express pride in national craft, labour, and self-reliance.
notes_20240423124135.simpleHindiExplanation: खादी सूत से बनने वाला स्वदेशी वस्त्र है। उसे गर्व से पहनना देशी कारीगरी, श्रम और आत्मनिर्भरता के सम्मान का प्रतीक बताया गया है।
notes_20240423124135.context: The record is dated 2023-07-30 and uses “सूत” as the prompt. It celebrates khadi as a domestic product and carries the established cultural association with swadeshi.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “unfortunate.”
The person who does no work remains truly unfortunate.
One who works continually does not remain helpless.
notes_20240423124139.childFriendlyEnglish: Steady effort can help a person move beyond helplessness, while refusing to act leaves opportunities unused.
notes_20240423124139.simpleHindiExplanation: जो व्यक्ति कर्म नहीं करता, वह अपने दुर्भाग्य में फंसा रहता है। निरंतर प्रयास करने वाला मनुष्य दीनता और असहायता से बाहर आने का मार्ग बना सकता है।
notes_20240423124139.context: The record is dated 2023-07-31, with an embedded date of 30/7/2023, and includes “अभागा” as the provided word. It presents a moral emphasis on effort, not a claim that work alone overcomes every hardship.

literalEnglish: Guardians always remain deployed at the border.
Whether there is a gale, a storm, or a dark night.
notes_20240423124143.childFriendlyEnglish: Border personnel stay on duty through dangerous weather and darkness to protect the country.
notes_20240423124143.simpleHindiExplanation: सीमा के रक्षक आंधी, तूफान और अंधेरी रात में भी तैनात रहते हैं। उनकी कठिन ड्यूटी, साहस और निरंतर सतर्कता को सम्मान दिया गया है।
notes_20240423124143.context: The record is dated 2023-07-31 and names “रक्षक” as the prompt. It praises border guards in general and does not identify a particular force, border, or incident.

literalEnglish: Do not calculate loss or gain, and do not dwell upon self-interest.
The wealth of contentment comes when one serves the greater good.
notes_20240423124151.childFriendlyEnglish: Helping others without always counting personal profit can bring a deep kind of satisfaction.
notes_20240423124151.simpleHindiExplanation: हर काम में अपना लाभ-हानि और स्वार्थ न देखने की सीख है। परमार्थ करने से मन को संतोष मिलता है, जिसे रचना सच्चा धन मानती है।
notes_20240423124151.context: The record is dated 2023-08-01 and uses “हानि” as the prompt. “परमार्थ” is interpreted as action for others or a higher good; the poem states an ethical ideal rather than financial advice.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “other.”
Arjuna sees only the target; nothing else is visible to him.
When he strikes the target, Draupadi is blessed.
notes_20240423124156.childFriendlyEnglish: Arjuna’s complete concentration helps him meet the challenge and win Draupadi’s svayamvara.
notes_20240423124156.simpleHindiExplanation: अर्जुन का ध्यान केवल लक्ष्य पर है, उन्हें कुछ और दिखाई नहीं देता। इसी एकाग्रता से वे लक्ष्य भेदते हैं और द्रौपदी के स्वयंवर में सफल होते हैं।
notes_20240423124156.context: The record is dated 2023-08-01 and includes “अन्य” as the provided word. It combines the familiar image of Arjuna’s single-pointed focus with Draupadi’s svayamvara; traditions may narrate these teaching and contest scenes separately.

literalEnglish: A fish rotting in the pond makes the water foul.
Its company causes suffering to all the others.
notes_20240423124200.childFriendlyEnglish: One harmful presence can spoil a shared environment and trouble everyone around it.
notes_20240423124200.simpleHindiExplanation: तालाब की एक सड़ी मछली पूरे पानी को गंदा कर देती है। उदाहरण से बताया गया है कि बुरी संगति या हानिकारक व्यवहार का असर पूरे समूह पर पड़ सकता है।
notes_20240423124200.context: The record is dated 2023-08-02 and names “संगति” as the prompt. The rotting fish functions as a moral analogy about harmful company, not as a report about an actual pond.

literalEnglish: Choose good company and abandon every harmful association.
One melon sees another and takes on its colour.
notes_20240423124208.childFriendlyEnglish: People influence one another, so keeping thoughtful and kind company can help good habits grow.
notes_20240423124208.simpleHindiExplanation: संगति का प्रभाव स्वभाव और व्यवहार पर पड़ता है। खरबूजे वाली कहावत से समझाया गया है कि अच्छी संगति चुननी चाहिए और कुसंग से बचना चाहिए।
notes_20240423124208.context: The record is dated 2023-08-02 and uses “संगति” as the prompt. Its second line draws on the proverb that one melon changes colour on seeing another, emphasizing social influence.

literalEnglish: The company of wicked people never overcomes the wise.
A lotus blooms in mud yet still remains pure.
notes_20240423124211.childFriendlyEnglish: A wise person can remain principled even in a bad environment, just as a lotus stays clean above muddy water.
notes_20240423124211.simpleHindiExplanation: प्रबुद्ध व्यक्ति दुर्जनों के बीच रहकर भी उनके बुरे प्रभाव से बच सकता है। कीचड़ में खिले शुद्ध कमल का उदाहरण आंतरिक चरित्र और विवेक को दर्शाता है।
notes_20240423124211.context: The record is dated 2023-08-02 and answers the prompt “संगति.” The lotus in mud is a conventional moral image for maintaining purity amid adverse surroundings.

literalEnglish: The peepal has become the beloved, and the climbing vine his beloved partner.
The union of the two looks very charming.
notes_20240423124356.childFriendlyEnglish: A vine winding around a peepal tree is imagined as a loving pair, turning a natural sight into a gentle picture of companionship.
notes_20240423124356.simpleHindiExplanation: पीपल और उस पर चढ़ी बेल को प्रियतम और प्रिया के रूप में देखा गया है। दोनों का साथ प्रकृति में सुंदर मेल और सहारे का भाव पैदा करता है।
notes_20240423124356.context: The record is dated 2023-08-03 and names “बेल” as the prompt. The romantic relationship is personification of a tree and vine, not a claim about a human couple.

literalEnglish: When the sunshine of Jyeshtha and Vaishakh leaves people exhausted,
drink bael fruit sherbet and the summer heat will ease.
For people with stomach ailments, bael has become precious.
It is filled with remarkable qualities beyond measure.
notes_20240423124400.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem values bael fruit as a cooling summer drink and as a traditional food associated with digestive comfort.
notes_20240423124400.simpleHindiExplanation: जेठ-वैशाख की गर्मी में बेल का शरबत शीतल पेय माना गया है। दूसरे दोहे में बेल को पेट के रोगों के लिए उपयोगी और गुणकारी बताया गया है।
notes_20240423124400.context: The record is dated 2023-08-03 and uses “बेल” to mean bael fruit. The health language reflects traditional understanding in the poem and should not replace medical diagnosis or treatment.

literalEnglish: Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh are present within the bael leaf.
Together with cannabis and thorn-apple, it is especially dear to Shiva.
notes_20240423124404.childFriendlyEnglish: The bael leaf is sacred in Shiva worship and is linked symbolically with the three great deities.
notes_20240423124404.simpleHindiExplanation: बेलपत्र को ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और महेश से जुड़ा पवित्र पत्र माना गया है। भांग और धतूरे के साथ इसका शिव-पूजन में विशेष स्थान बताया गया है।
notes_20240423124404.context: The record is dated 2023-08-03 and names “बेल” as the prompt. It reflects Hindu devotional associations of bilva leaves and Shiva; practices and explanations can differ by region and tradition.

literalEnglish: The guilty commit crimes and obtain bail.
Those who are innocent end up receiving jail.
notes_20240423124408.childFriendlyEnglish: The couplet protests an apparent injustice: offenders may secure bail while innocent people can remain imprisoned.
notes_20240423124408.simpleHindiExplanation: रचना न्याय-व्यवस्था की विडंबना पर व्यंग्य करती है—अपराधी जमानत पा लेते हैं, जबकि निर्दोष जेल पहुंच सकते हैं। यह न्याय में असमानता की चिंता व्यक्त करती है।
notes_20240423124408.context: The record is dated 2023-08-03 and uses “बेल,” here as the English-derived legal word “bail.” It is a general satirical contrast and supplies no evidence about a specific case.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “boon.”
For human life, the mobile phone is a boon.
Google is giving everyone knowledge of the whole world.
notes_20240423124414.childFriendlyEnglish: Phones and online search can place a vast amount of information within people’s reach, making technology feel like a gift.
notes_20240423124414.simpleHindiExplanation: मोबाइल और गूगल के माध्यम से दुनिया भर की जानकारी आसानी से मिल सकती है। रचना इस उपयोगी तकनीकी पहुंच को मानव जीवन के लिए वरदान मानती है।
notes_20240423124414.context: The record timestamp is 2023-08-03, while the embedded date is 4/8/2023, and includes “वरदान” as the provided word. It praises information access through phones and Google without discussing limits such as accuracy, privacy, or unequal access.

literalEnglish: Let Hindi become the language of the people; put it into use.
Everyone should speak in Hindi with children as well.
May the language advance and Hindi be heard all around.
Hearing it from people living abroad makes the heart swell with feeling.
notes_20240423124421.childFriendlyEnglish: Regularly speaking Hindi at home and across generations can help it flourish, and hearing it far from India can create a strong sense of connection.
notes_20240423124421.simpleHindiExplanation: हिंदी का विकास उसके नियमित प्रयोग से होगा, इसलिए बच्चों से भी हिंदी बोलने का आग्रह है। विदेश में रहने वालों से हिंदी सुनकर अपनापन और भावनात्मक जुड़ाव महसूस होता है।
notes_20240423124421.context: The record is dated 2023-08-04 and names “भाषा” as the prompt. It encourages Hindi use among children and the diaspora; “प्रवासी” is read broadly as people living away from their homeland.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “choosing in marriage.”
A virtuous person should choose someone virtuous.
Then life may pass happily, without needless disruption.
notes_20240423124428.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem advises choosing a life partner for good character, hoping shared values will support a peaceful marriage.
notes_20240423124428.simpleHindiExplanation: जीवनसाथी का वरण करते समय गुण और अच्छे चरित्र को महत्व देने की सलाह है। समान मूल्य और समझ सुखी तथा व्यवधान-रहित दांपत्य में सहायक हो सकते हैं।
notes_20240423124428.context: The record timestamp is 2023-08-04, while the embedded date is 5/8/2023, and includes “वरण” as the provided word. The final promise is aspirational; compatibility and circumstances involve more than virtue alone.

literalEnglish: It identifies an offender by scent.
A police tracking dog is clever and well trained.
notes_20240423124434.childFriendlyEnglish: A trained police dog can follow scent clues and help investigators search for a suspect.
notes_20240423124434.simpleHindiExplanation: पुलिस का प्रशिक्षित खोजी कुत्ता गंध के आधार पर अपराधी या संदिग्ध का पता लगाने में मदद करता है। उसकी सूंघने की शक्ति और प्रशिक्षण की प्रशंसा की गई है।
notes_20240423124434.context: The record is dated 2023-08-05 and uses “गंध” as the prompt. It describes the general role of a police scent-tracking dog, not a particular investigation.

literalEnglish: The fragrance that rises from the garden of one’s field of action
is what people recognize when they form relationships.
notes_20240423124442.childFriendlyEnglish: A person’s work and conduct create a reputation, and others often decide whether to connect with them by that impression.
notes_20240423124442.simpleHindiExplanation: मनुष्य के कर्म उसके व्यक्तित्व की सुगंध की तरह पहचान बनाते हैं। लोग उसी काम, आचरण और प्रतिष्ठा को देखकर संबंध स्थापित करते हैं।
notes_20240423124442.context: The record is dated 2023-08-05 and names “गंध” as the prompt. “Fragrance” and “garden” are metaphors for the reputation produced by one’s actions; the kind of relationship is not specified.

literalEnglish: Provided word: “forest.”
After destroying rivers and forests, the mountains stand desolate.
Humanity, why are you playing recklessly with nature?
notes_20240423124446.childFriendlyEnglish: Destroying forests and damaging rivers leaves landscapes barren, so people must stop treating nature carelessly.
notes_20240423124446.simpleHindiExplanation: नदियों और वनों के विनाश से पर्वत और पूरा पर्यावरण उजड़ता है। मनुष्य से प्रश्न किया गया है कि वह प्रकृति के साथ खिलवाड़ क्यों कर रहा है।
notes_20240423124446.context: The record timestamp is 2023-08-05, while the embedded date is 6/8/2023, and includes “वन” as the provided word. It is a broad environmental warning and names no particular river, forest, development, or disaster.
